title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
original_title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
tagline: Welcome to the Second Quarter Quell.
overview_en: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

title: Heartland
tagline: The brightest stars hide the darkest secrets.
overview_en: Former country music legend Misty Jones returns to Nashville to unravel the truth behind her rising-star niece's disappearance.

title: Allen
overview_en: 20 years after his encounter with an alien, Petey never moved on. Now his old friend has returned, and the reason why is complicated — and unexpected.
overview_id: Petey tak pernah melupakan pertemuannya dengan alien meski sudah 20 tahun. Kini, teman lamanya ini kembali dengan alasan yang rumit—dan tak terduga.

title: The Christmas Switch
overview_en: Craving a change of pace, work-hard-play-hard city girl Freddie swaps lives with her homebody sister Mattie at Christmas time, only to unwrap a whole new kind of mess.

title: Snoopy Presents: 12 Days of Snoopy
tagline: Even good dogs have naughty days.
overview_en: Eager to get off Santa's naughty list, Snoopy goes all out to be the nicest beagle in town.
overview_id: Karena ingin dihapus dari daftar anak nakal Sinterklas, Snoopy berusaha jadi beagle paling baik.

title: Never Surrender
overview_en: When a deadly gang descends on his remote home, a guilt-ridden veteran and the estranged grandchildren he barely knows must unite to survive.
overview_id: Ketika geng mematikan menyerbu rumah terpencilnya, seorang veteran yang dihantui rasa bersalah dan cucu-cucu yang nyaris tak dikenalnya harus bersatu demi bertahan hidup.

title: Ebenezer
tagline: Before he was Scrooge, he was…
overview_en: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

title: The Gospel of Christmas
tagline: Do you hear what I hear?
overview_en: A struggling pastor moves his family to a troubled New York neighborhood, where they must save a neglected church from foreclosure before Christmas.

title: A Place to Heal
overview_en: In a French public hospital, the adolescent psychiatry unit moves to the erratic rhythm of teenagers coming and going - many carrying heavy past baggage - while Etienne and his medical team navigate the relentless cycle of treating, listening, and confronting the raw edges of suffering. Young Lucia knows the ward too well. After being brought back yet again by the police, she reunites with her friend Eloïse and encounters a constellation of young patients, each wrestling with their own storms. At times, there is laughter, small breakthroughs, moments of fragile hope. But the balance is shaky, and the arrival of a new patient will shatter it entirely.

title: How to Rob a Bank
overview_en: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

title: Ghost Soldier
overview_en: Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald has spent years living quietly off the grid, hiding from a past few people know anything about. But when a powerful foreign corporation moves into his hometown to seize his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz is forced to reveal who he really is: a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with experimental technology, lethal combat skills, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz wages a one-man war against an enemy that never saw him coming.

title: I Play Rocky
overview_en: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

title: Being Heumann
overview_en: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.
overview_id: Gigih, berani, dan enggan lagi dianggap sebagai beban, Judy Heumann mengubah kemarahannya menjadi sebuah revolusi. Pada tahun 1977, dia bersama lebih dari 100 demonstran hak-hak penyandang disabilitas menyuarakan pesan kelantangan yang sama: Sistemnya yang rusak, bukan kami.

title: Unprotected: Murder in Galicia
overview_en: Documentary film that tells the story of Isabel Fuentes. In April 2015, alleged burglars left her on the brink of death in her own home, in the village of Pazos, in Verín. From the very beginning, the Guardia Civil sergeant in charge of the case suspected that the account of what had happened did not add up and tried to protect Isabel from further attack.

title: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
original_title: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
overview_en: Reconnecting with a pack of wolves he has followed for seven years, Bertie sets out to capture one of the Arctic's most dangerous and rarely filmed hunts: wolves taking on a bull moose, prey roughly ten times their size. Led by Kona, a striking white breeding male, the pack faces a critical winter as dwindling food supplies, an encroaching rival wolf and an aging leader threaten its survival.

title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend
overview_en: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

title: One Year to Live, Buy a Man
overview_en: Given a year to live, frugal 40-year-old Yui finally lets herself spend: "buying" nightclub host Sena. What begins as a contract takes an unexpected turn.

title: Scene
overview_en: Inbaraj, a police officer, is forced to come back from retirement when a new case resembles one he closed years ago. This time, he must solve it with a chaotic and troublesome team. As they struggle to work together and deal with the twists and turns of the case, the investigation takes them on a chaotic and unpredictable ride.

title: Se domani non torno
overview_en: It follows the tragic life of Giulia Cecchettin, starting from the private pain of her father, Gino Cecchettin, and culminating in a cinematic story that stems from the book of the victim's father, entitled Dear Giulia.

title: The Nameless Ballad
overview_en: Under pressure from his record label, a young musician in crisis takes refuge in an isolated Italian villa to find inspiration for his next album. But the discovery of an ancient piano and a forgotten diary drags him into a spiral of twisted obsessions, supernatural visions and ghostly presences that finally push him to the brink of madness.

title: A Dog's Perfect Christmas
overview_en: When a medical emergency pulls the Goss family apart, determined dog Winstead will do all he can to bring his humans back together before Christmas Eve.
overview_id: Saat keadaan darurat medis membuat keluarga Goss terpecah, Winstead si anjing gigih akan melakukan segalanya demi menyatukan keluarga manusianya sebelum Malam Natal.

title: Club Kid
overview_en: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

title: Women on Trial
overview_en: 1972. A landmark trial shakes France as young Marie-Claire is prosecuted for having an illegal abortion with the help of her mother and two other defendants. In a courtroom governed by men, the verdict seems inevitable: prison for the women, while the rapist goes unpunished. Their last hope lies with Gisèle Halimi, a fearless lawyer known for openly challenging patriarchy and confronting the system that condemns victims and lets perpetrators walk free. Alongside the accused, Gisèle will not only change their fate, but, against all odds, transform the condition of women forever

title: Godzilla Minus Zero
tagline: There is no third time. Everything ends here.
overview_en: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.

title: Model Citizen
tagline: Bury the past. Control the truth.
overview_en: With his memories gone and his past a blur, ex-cop Steven Bay seeks treatment for his amnesia while working on an isolated farm. Instead, he's met with rising hostility, strange surveillance, and instincts he can’t fully control. When the pressure becomes unbearable, Bay begins a desperate hunt for the truth behind his fractured reality.

title: A Story of Derry
overview_en: Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood...where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit.
overview_id: Ratusan tahun sebelum Pennywise, tiga remaja menjelajahi Western Wood, tempat mereka bertemu dengan roh kuno yang mengerikan.

title: The Cat in the Hat
tagline: The cat's out of the bag.
overview_en: Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.

title: Wild Horse Nine
tagline: Sometimes you've got to do a terrible thing for the greater good.
overview_en: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

title: Collision Course
overview_en: Spain, 2013. After robbing a bank, a getaway crash reveals the hidden side of each thief, exposing betrayals and lies that began long before the heist.

title: The Birthday​ Gift​
overview_en: Single mother Marlene Frischmann organizes a birthday party for her son Theo at her brother's chic country villa, which quickly spirals into family drama, world-view quarrels, and chaos.

title: Dead Howling
tagline: When the dead rise, the beast hunts.
overview_en: A werewolf hunts zombies after losing his family. He meets two humans seeking sanctuary and joins their quest, protecting them with his powers. Their journey grows perilous as zombies start evolving.

title: The Mongoose
overview_en: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

title: The Awakening
overview_en: An elite military unit on a mission in the South American jungle encounters a deadly supernatural force revealing an ancient presence that continues to claim anyone who dares enter its domain.

title: You, Me, Us
overview_en: A couple faces the difficult path to adoption, determined to become parents despite their complex vulnerabilities.

title: God Laughs
overview_en: In the heart of the 17th century, Friar Leopoldo da Casamacchia recounts the Gospel with a joy and freedom never seen before. While the Church speaks in Latin, he speaks to the people of a God who is close to them, capable of bringing comfort, hope, and even of laughing alongside them. His voice spreads from village to village, winning over thousands of people and emptying the churches. The echo of his message reaches as far as Rome, where the Pope entrusts the case to Cardinal Maculani, the most influential inquisitor of the time. What begins as a trial turns into an unexpected confrontation, capable of shaking seemingly unshakable convictions. While Leopoldo’s fate seems sealed, doubt begins to change even those who judge him. Because you can silence a voice, but not what that voice has left behind in others.

title: Moulin
overview_en: In June 1943, Jean Moulin, leader of the French Resistance, is arrested while attempting to reunite the forces of the "Armée Secrète." Interrogated by Klaus Barbie, the head of the Gestapo in Lyon, Moulin is drawn into a relentless confrontation.

title: The Phantom of the Opera
overview_en: Anastasia, an 18-year-old ballet dancer at the Opéra Garnier, becomes the obsession of a disfigured man living in the opera's underground labyrinth.

title: Words of Love
overview_en: For 14 years, Erika has been the anchor of a household that rarely stands still, doing her best to raise teenage Abigail, her whirlwind little brother, Yoni, and a dog with an extreme devotion to cheese. When Abi’s desire to meet her absent father grows into a full-blown obsession and word spreads he’s been seen nearby, Erika fears the fragile balance will collapse for good. Instead, the unpredictable journey that follows brings mother and daughter to see each other anew, steering their lively, lovable family toward a happy new chapter.

title: Drive - The Pretenders
overview_en: A young mechanic fakes an engagement with racing's most scandalous star — officially for his reputation, secretly for her own shot behind the wheel. But soon the lie threatens to destroy everything — including what's already become so much more than just a deal.

title: Surviving Hurricane Otis
overview_en: Two estranged brothers struggle to survive Hurricane Otis in Acapulco, where their bond and courage turn adversity into hope.

title: Gajab Raat
overview_en: A corrupt, troubled cop's night spirals out of control when a reluctant act of mercy toward an injured girl pulls him into a deadly web of crime.

title: A Talent for Murder
tagline: The end is where the plotting begins.
overview_en: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
original_title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
tagline: They're not back... they never left.
overview_en: It's a matter of life and death for Alison, Mike, Mia and the Ghosts.

title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
overview_en: After twenty years spent "chillin', tokin' and bonin'", Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child's very existence.

title: Wicker
overview_en: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

title: Klara and the Sun
overview_en: When Klara, an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home, meets Josie, each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother and they've suffered great loss, but Klara's innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie's complicated world.

title: Coward
overview_en: Surrounded by brutality but bound by a tender intimacy, two World War I soldiers find a fragile sanctuary of love and art amid the shadows of the Belgian trenches.

title: La Gradiva
overview_en: Amid the ancient ruins of Pompeii, a group of French teenagers on a class trip to Naples grapple with anxiety and exhilaration ahead of their high school graduation.

title: Karma
overview_en: In a village in northern Spain, Jeanne tries to rebuild her life with Daniel, who knows nothing about her troubled past. One day, Jeanne's six-year-old godson mysteriously disappears and Jeanne becomes the main suspect.

title: A Woman Today
overview_en: The life of a young woman is turned upside down after a violent assault, making her realize the fragility of her freedom.

title: Hot Wheels Let's Race: Attack of the T-Rex
original_title: Hot Wheels Let's Race: Attack of the T-Rex
overview_en: When a giant T-Rex threatens Hot Wheels City, it's up to Coop and his friends to race to the rescue and save the day.

title: Wildwood
tagline: How far would you go for those you love?
overview_en: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

title: Clayface
overview_en: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

title: You Can See Everything
overview_en: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.

title: Masterplan
overview_en: When a legendary thief sets his sights on the Mona Lisa, he recruits two young strangers to help him before revealing they are long-lost siblings… and oh yes, by the way, he is their father. Thrown into a chaotic reunion they never asked for, this new family must learn to work together — and try not to kill each other — if they want any chance at pulling off the heist of the century.
overview_id: Saat seorang pencuri legendaris mengincar Mona Lisa, dia merekrut dua orang asing: Chiara, pakar kejahatan siber asal Italia, dan Jay, ahli bahan peledak asal Prancis. Dia lalu mengaku sebagai ayah mereka. Terjebak dalam reuni keluarga yang kacau, keluarga baru ini harus belajar bekerja sama dan berusaha tak saling bunuh demi melancarkan pencurian terbesar abad ini.

title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
original_title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
overview_en: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily cancelled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.

title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
original_title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
overview_en: Go down a wormhole in this documentary on master of deadpan humor Norm Macdonald, whose life and career were uncompromising yet full of contradictions.

title: Clean Hands
overview_en: Based on a true story, a veteran narcotics officer turned recovery advocate and his daughter, who struggles with addiction, confront the American drug crisis from opposing sides of the law while navigating their complicated family bond.

title: The Storm
overview_en: When a storm traps old university pals at a luxury lodge, their civilized birthday bash spirals into a cyclone of betrayals, grudges and unfiltered chaos.

title: Je so’ pazzo
overview_en: Je so’ pazzo is an intense portrait of Pino Daniele—a rebellious soul born in the alleys of Naples who revolutionized Italian music by blending blues, jazz, and Neapolitan tradition. The film chronicles his rise, from a childhood marked by abandonment to his legendary 1981 concert before a crowd of 200,000. Amidst family conflicts, personal vulnerabilities, and deep loves, Pino finds a musical language to express what words cannot. Yet success brings new challenges: an unresolved relationship with his father, the burden of expectations, and the risk of repeating past mistakes. It is not merely the story of an extraordinary musician, but that of a man grappling with himself, seeking reconciliation with his roots and the love of a city that never stopped waiting for him.

title: Jailer 2
overview_en: When a dangerous syndicate threatens his family, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver to battle enemies from the shadows.

title: Whalefall
overview_en: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

title: Minotaur
overview_en: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

title: Les Misérables
overview_en: After enduring 19 years in prison for stealing a loaf of bread, Jean Valjean emerges a hardened man. He seeks redemption by reinventing himself as a respected dignitary under a new identity. He promises Fantine, a dying factory worker, to rescue and protect her daughter Cosette, who is being exploited and mistreated by the deceitful Thénardier family. As Valjean raises Cosette as his own, he is relentlessly pursued by Inspector Javert. Admist the social unrest shaking France, the fates of Valjean, Cosette, her lover Marius, and Javert become intertwined in a turbulent, revolutionary Paris. Through struggles, sacrifices, and a deep yearning for justice, Valjean strives to complete his journey of redemption and offer Cosette a future of love and freedom.

title: Iron Boy
overview_en: 11-year-old Christophe tries to live up to his rigid and distant father on the family farm in rural France. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning — on the tractor, at school, at dinner... A doctor finds the solution: Christophe must wear an iron corset to keep himself upright. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, Christophe discovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend, and follows her into his first mischief.

title: Street Fighter
overview_en: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

title: Let's Have Kids!
tagline: Pregnancy is hard. Bring a friend.
overview_en: Two best friends, Emma and Phoebe, decide to get pregnant simultaneously to navigate motherhood together, but their friendship is tested when only one of them conceives.

title: Remain Calm
overview_en: The story follows the two gas station clerks whose routine night shift turns into a fight for survival. A government agent warns them about Mr. Frett, a terrifying creature that tracks and hunts people who show any signs of anxiety, stress, or panic. To stay alive, the characters must force themselves into a state of aggressive positivity and calm.

title: Instadocs: AI Gone Wild
tagline: Did AI just commit a felony?
overview_en: Did AI just commit a felony? "Instadocs" investigates the Hugging Face hack and why this cyberattack may be a warning shot for humanity's future.

title: Apocalypse Z: New World
overview_en: The Canary Islands have become Europe’s last refuge following the outbreak of the TSJ virus. When a special mission sets out for the mainland in search of vital supplies, Roberto joins the team with questionable intentions. The dangerous operation turns into a desperate race for survival, and Roberto and his companions find themselves caught between hordes of infected and divided loyalties.

title: Animals
overview_en: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.
overview_id: Saat putra mereka diculik, seorang kandidat wali kota LA dan istrinya kalang kabut mengumpulkan tebusan sambil membuat keputusan yang bisa menghancurkan hidup mereka.

title: Reporting Live
tagline: Some stories refuse to be buried.
overview_en: A young reporter and her reluctant cameraman chase a story, only to get entangled in an illegal sand-mining racket run by a ruthless syndicate.

title: Tenzing
overview_en: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.
overview_id: Seorang pria yang gigih memulai misi berisiko tinggi, dan menaklukkan rintangan yang tampak mustahil, demi mewujudkan impiannya menjadi orang pertama yang mencapai puncak Gunung Everest.

title: V/H/S/MIXTAPE
overview_en: V/H/S/MIXTAPE cranks the volume on horror with a blood-soaked collection of cursed music videos, terrifying performances, and found footage. Press play. Pray it stops.

title: Musk
tagline: An unflinching look at Earth's most unchecked man.
overview_en: An incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world's most heralded "inventor-entrepreneur" who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live.

title: Devour
overview_en: Stranded after a disastrous gig, an all-girl heavy metal band finds a woman in danger in a town ruled by a warlock, and crawling with cannibals, vampires, and a deadly werewolf, forcing them to fight for survival.

title: R.L. Stine's Pumpkinhead 2
overview_en: Sam and Becka race to stop a new Pumpkinhead curse from claiming the entire town of Redhaven.

title: The Beast
tagline: You know Air Force One. Now meet...
overview_en: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the United States, the president must fight back by utilizing the highly classified offensive capabilities of his armored limousine, nicknamed The Beast.

title: Angel and the Badman
overview_en: A wounded outlaw finds unexpected mercy in the care of a rancher's daughter. The hope of love pulls him toward a different life until the law, and his violent past, close in on his new home. Now he must choose the kind of man he'll become.

title: Therapy Done Right
overview_en: A psychoanalyst who's lost faith in traditional therapy crosses every boundary to help a blocked novelist in this cutting Argentine dark comedy.

title: The Spiral
overview_en: On a stormy night in Rome, Anna arrives at her daughter Alice’s apartment with a devastating confession: their entire family history is built on a lie. Twenty years earlier, after a horrific accident that nearly cost Alice her leg, Anna claims she made a pact with a mysterious Stranger to save her. But the miracle came at a price. What she believed was a single desperate bargain has in fact unleashed a spiraling chain reaction — a domino effect of increasingly dark events that have haunted their lives ever since. Now, the Stranger has come to collect. And Anna is convinced that only Alice can break the spiral and set things right. But at what cost?

title: Other Mommy
overview_en: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

title: The Social Reckoning
overview_en: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

title: Love of Your Life
overview_en: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.
overview_id: Disutradarai Rachel Morrison, LOVE OF YOUR LIFE mengikuti Maya, yang pertemuannya dengan Charlie memicu kisah cinta luar biasa dan masa depan di luar bayangannya. Saat masa depan itu berubah, Maya dihadapkan pada kehidupan baru yang tak terduga, memaksanya memahami siapa dirinya, apa yang diinginkannya, dan cara mencintai lagi.

title: All About Corinne
overview_en: Corinne Maclou is a background actor who dreams of one day being more than an extra. Confident her breakthrough is right around the corner, she befriends famous actor Sandrine Kiberlain, hoping it will help her achieve her goal.

title: Matchbox the Movie
tagline: Save the world, bring your friends.
overview_en: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.
overview_id: Ketika sekelompok mantan teman masa kecil bertemu kembali, reuni mereka menjadi kacau saat tak sengaja menemukan konspirasi internasional yang berbahaya dan kini mereka harus menyelamatkan dunia.

title: Family Guy Happy Hell-o-ween
tagline: It's not "the devil you know", it's "The Devil, y'know?"
overview_en: After unexpectedly dying and being sent to Hell, Stewie and Brian’s constant nagging leads The Devil to quit, passing control of Hell to them.

title: Doing Life
tagline: Choose a love that breaks all chains.
overview_en: A single mother and an incarcerated man forge an unlikely bond through heartfelt letters, unlocking a door to redemption, hope and love against all odds.

title: Drishyam: The Conclusion
overview_en: Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.

title: Infirmary
overview_en: A guard vanished on his first night at an old psych hospital in 2023. His bodycam footage shows unexplainable incidents that continue to baffle investigators.

title: The Last First: Winter K2
tagline: Reach the summit or lose everything.
overview_en: A historic race to become the first to summit K2 in winter unravels into tragedy, exposing how ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory can be as dangerous as the mountain itself.
overview_id: Perlombaan menjadi yang pertama menaklukkan K2 di musim dingin berujung tragedi, mengungkap bahwa ambisi dan ego bisa sama mematikannya dengan gunung itu sendiri.

title: Schumacher ’94 – The Birth of a Legend
tagline: One goal. One season. The start of something great.
overview_en: Michael Schumacher's first World Championship win roars to life through personal interviews and archival footage of the legendary 1994 Formula 1 season.

title: Stranglehold
tagline: It's the most wonderful crime of the year.
overview_en: Fed up with their lives, barely eking by in small-town Arkansas, a stripper with dreams and her Army vet husband decide to rob the strip club that employs her.

title: Beware Boiúna
tagline: Witness terror on a gigantic scale.
overview_en: A medical mission deep in the Amazon becomes a desperate fight for survival when a colossal ancient predator awakens, turning the jungle into a deadly battleground where nature decides who lives and dies.

title: Baththa
overview_en: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally traps a feared gangster inside a deserted school toilet. As the gangster is forced to confront hunger, loneliness and his own vulnerability, an unlikely bond begins to grow between the two.

title: The City of the Living
overview_en: Luca is twenty-three years old. He lives with an adoptive family who loves him. He moves between the suburbs and the city center with his friends and has a girlfriend with whom he shares a love that is young, yet significant for them both. Luca is searching for his path at an age when everything still feels possible and, at the same time, already lost; in this pursuit, he leads a double life. One night, after a seemingly chance encounter, the trajectory of Luca’s life is shattered, colliding with blind and senseless violence.

title: Stream of Terror
tagline: IT’S NOT JUST A LIVESTREAM. IT’S A DEATH SENTENCE.
overview_en: When her picture-perfect life is shattered by a series of live streamed murders, Tiffany must confront a masked killer targeting her inner circle-before she becomes the last to go live.

title: A Bit of Light
overview_en: After being arrested and having his medical practice shut down, an Iranian doctor loses faith in the future and resolves to end his life - but one final day among his family begins to unsettle his decision.

title: Verity
tagline: There is no light where we're going.
overview_en: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.

title: Livestream from Hell
overview_en: When Kevin Hart teams up with fellow comedian, Druski, and streamer, Kai Cenat for a record-breaking livestream at his tech-savvy mansion, things go hilariously off the rails, until the pranks turn to panic, and a real murder mystery unfolds on camera, trapping the trio and their celebrity guests in a high-stakes, horror-comedy whodunnit watched by millions.

title: LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER
tagline: The hardest part of ending is starting again.
overview_en: After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, this documentary weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

title: A Man of His Time
overview_en: September 1940. Henri Marre arrives alone in Vichy as the authoritarian regime settles in. Broke, estranged from his family, and carrying copies of his self-published manifesto Notre Salut (Our Salvation), the 49-year-old is determined to secure what he believes is his rightful place in the new administration. In his writing, Henri sets out his patriotic convictions and his engineer’s methodology: efficiency above all. Claiming he wants to help save France after defeat, he does whatever is required to remain useful, serving the machinery of the new order with increasing skill. But he may be pursuing something more urgent: escape from his own ruin

title: The Doll
overview_en: Wealthy merchant Stanislaw Wokulski falls tragically in love with beautiful yet vain Izabela Lecka. His unfulfilled love leads to many foolish decisions sealing his fate.

title: A Girl’s Story
overview_en: During a book signing in Normandy, Annie Ernaux, 70, revisits her memories of the summer of 1958, when she was 17. That summer, she left her hometown to work as a camp counsellor. At the first party, the head counsellor set out to deflower her. Finding him handsome, she lets him do it, as if against her will... Her body becomes a foreign place for her, an offering to be sacrificed.

title: The Nice Ones
overview_en: When Kate joins her boyfriend’s friends at a remote countryside retreat, old wounds resurface as strange lights appear in the sky. As unease grows, members of the group begin to change—becoming unnervingly calm, kind, and “nice.” Dismissed as unstable, Kate struggles to convince the others something is wrong before the force behind it spreads.

title: Digger
tagline: A man. A plan. A meltdown.
overview_en: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

title: A Better Jianghu
overview_en: Two individuals, the scholar Shen Fang and the knight-errant Luo Han, steal a huge sum of silver from the official Qin Hui to support the anti-Jin rebels, devising a grand deception to combat the imperial guard and rally people from all walks of life to their cause during the Southern Song Dynasty.

title: Il mio nome è Carlo
tagline: The movie about Carlo Acutis's life.
overview_en: The movie traces three key moments: the six-year-old boy, already driven by an extraordinary spiritual sensitivity; the eleven-year-old boy, curious and brilliant; and the fifteen-year-old in his first year of high school, self-aware and determined, capable of approaching everyday life with an extraordinary outlook.

title: La Bola Negra
overview_en: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
original_title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
tagline: To be a parent is to be at war.
overview_en: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

title: UNABOMBER
tagline: Where brilliance ends, the madness begins.
overview_en: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.
overview_id: Di drama yang terinspirasi kisah nyata ini, jalan Ted Kaczynski dari seorang genius dan objek percobaan di Harvard sampai menjadi Unabomber terkuak saat FBI memburunya.

title: NAZA
tagline: A window into systems of mass killing.
overview_en: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.

title: Dorothy
overview_en: In rural Tamil Nadu, two inseparable childhood friends navigate a world shaped by caste, violence and toxic masculinity, until a compassionate woman enters their lives and quietly challenges the social order around them.

title: The Deputy
overview_en: A young sheriff's deputy finds himself in the crosshairs of dangerous criminals when the dead body he is assigned to keep an eye on disappears from a crime scene.

title: Buzzkill
overview_en: A group of sorority sisters end up trapped with a murderer. Nora’s tipsy memories hold the clues to figuring out who is killing their friends, but she can only remember them when she’s drunk.

title: Crawlers
overview_en: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

title: The Florist
overview_en: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

title: The Cycle
tagline: You can't bury the past forever.
overview_en: A daughter unravels her father's dark past after his body, missing for 36 years, is found at a horrific crime scene.

title: Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!
original_title: Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!
overview_en: Spidey and the Avengers' Halloween plans are turned upside down by the mysterious Hallows' Eve, who plays magical tricks on trick or treaters and plans to ruin Halloween forever.

title: Charlie Harper
overview_en: As an ambitious chef and her struggling partner move to a new city to start fresh, the stark divide in their drives tests the limits of their love.

title: Primetime
tagline: Are you ready to make television history?
overview_en: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.

title: Sense and Sensibility
tagline: No one knows your heart like a sister.
overview_en: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

title: Possible Love
overview_en: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

title: The Love Hypothesis
overview_en: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.
overview_id: Berdasarkan novel laris New York Times, Hipotesis Cinta menceritakan Olive, calon Ph.D. yang spontan mencium profesor paling galak di departemennya, Adam Carlsen. Kebutuhan bersama mereka untuk hubungan palsu berubah menjadi eksperimen kecocokan yang mungkin memecahkan masalah cinta.

title: The Paradise
overview_en: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalized tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.

title: Another Day
overview_en: Over an eight-year journey in Paris, a struggling young actress turns to alcohol to cope with her anxieties, spiraling into self-destruction before finding a path toward recovery through a new romance and her ailing sister.

title: Red Rocks
overview_en: On the French Riviera, two gangs of kids compete in the perilous game of cliff jumping. Géo, barely five years old, discovers over the course of a summer a world where friendship blends with rivalry, and where the first stirrings of the heart emerge against the dazzling Mediterranean landscape.

title: One Last Shot
tagline: One last traitor. One last mission. One last fight.
overview_en: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

title: Heart of the Beast
overview_en: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

title: You+Me - Against the World
tagline: He runs from everything. Except her.
overview_en: Alma Lancaster, 18, appears to lead a perfect life within a wealthy family who believes she is studying law. In secret, she pursues her true dream: filmmaking. On campus, she meets Vadim Arcadi, 20, a magnetic and solitary rebel with a troubled past. Forced to collaborate on a student film, they clash, grow closer and fall in love — despite themselves. But someone is watching them, determined to tear them apart and expose secrets that could destroy both Alma and Vadim.

title: Lust Stories 3
overview_en: Through four bite-sized yet emotionally resonant films, the anthology once again explores lust, love, relationships, and repressed desire, offering fresh perspectives on intimacy, longing, and human connection in all their complexity.

title: Best of the Best
tagline: It takes two to take over.
overview_en: Two childhood besties join UCLA's competitive Bollywood-fusion dance team, only to find the road to the US championships is fiercer than they imagined.

title: The History of Concrete
tagline: Wow! What a Material! It Makes Up Sidewalks!
overview_en: After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, filmmaker John Wilson tries to use the same formula to sell a documentary about concrete.

title: Tiny Fugitives
overview_en: A reckless group of twelve year olds set out on a mission to spend the rest of their lives at sleepaway camp. They'll just have to get past Bob - the camp's deranged, relentless, 50-year-old lifer counselor.

title: The Musical
tagline: It's not personal. It's middle school.
overview_en: A frustrated playwright and middle school drama teacher plots revenge against his nemesis, the school principal, by secretly staging an outrageous play to sabotage his chances of winning a prestigious award.

title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
original_title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
tagline: What's that coming over the hill?
overview_en: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go awry when a wild beast appears in the woods.

title: Thomas & Friends: Really Helpful Engines
tagline: All aboard for an exciting adventure!
overview_en: When Gordon needs help, Thomas takes on extra work alone to prove himself. But a busy day on Sodor shows that even useful engines need their friends.

title: Resident Evil
overview_en: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.
overview_id: Kurir medis Bryan tanpa sadar mendapati dirinya berjuang demi kelangsungan hidup, saat suatu malam yang menentukan dan mengerikan runtuh menjadi kekacauan di sekelilingnya.

title: The Intern
overview_en: Ki-ho, a retiree with 37 years of experience, joins fashion start-up WOO22 a senior intern, he struggles with its digital, unconventional culture. Despite their differences, Ki-ho and Sun-woo, the start-up's young CEO, learn from each other and form an unexpected bond.

title: The Weight
tagline: A tale of good and evil.
overview_en: When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.

title: The Birthday Party
overview_en: Thomas, Nora and their teenage daughter Ida live on remote marshland. Social contact is limited, as they only have one neighbour, Cristina, an Italian painter. As the two households plan a surprise birthday party for Nora, strange disturbances begin to occur and unease rolls over the marsh.

title: Think Good
overview_en: When Gil meets Jacques, their love seems irresistible. And when she unexpectedly falls pregnant, he convinces her to start a family. However, their hasty marriage reveals that she is not as deeply rooted into the Jewish faith as he is. Jacques reassures her: "Think good and it will be good". Little by little, Gil realizes the insidious control he exerts over her life...

title: After Impact
overview_en: After losing his father, Ethan Nichols inherits one of the largest greenhouses in the country, just as the world faces a devastating threat from an approaching asteroid. As society begins to unravel, Ethan grapples with personal betrayal, overwhelming loneliness, and the growing fear that survival may come at the cost of his humanity. Seeking refuge in his family’s bunker, Ethan endures the harsh aftermath of the impact, wrestling with physical injury and emotional despair. When a faint voice crackles over his radio, Ethan discovers he's not as alone as he believed.

title: The Last Kiss
overview_en: A young woman discovers she can foresee the death of anyone she kisses, and when a vision predicts her crush will die in a murder spree targeting her closest friends, she races to uncover the killer before more lives are lost.

title: Run Hide Fight: Infidels
overview_en: When radical Islamist terrorists hijack a liberal college's pro-Palestine encampment, a ragtag band of red-blooded students, a security guard, and a Delta Force vet must arm up to save their clueless peers.

title: The Last Photograph
overview_en: An ex-DEA operative must return to the mountains of South America in an effort to find his missing niece and nephew, following the brutal murders of their diplomat parents. Enlisting the help of a washed-up junkie war photographer, the only person to have seen the face of the killers, he sets out, determined to find the children and the truth, but soon learns he must also face the ghosts of his past.

title: The Good Lawyer
overview_en: After a courtroom overdose lands him in rehab, a lawyer has one week to save his career and prepare for his own trial, with the help of a dogged intern.
overview_id: Dikirim ke rehab setelah overdosis di ruang sidang, seorang pengacara punya satu minggu untuk menyelamatkan karier dan mempersiapkan persidangan, dibantu pemagang gigih.

title: Don't Move
overview_en: Follows a prehistoric arachnid that terrifies a stranded group of campers who hike into the wrong woods. Based on the spine-tingling horror novel from the actor best known as "Murr" on TV's Impractical Jokers.

title: Look Back
tagline: "Keep your eyes on my back and you'll grow too."
overview_en: Popular, outgoing Fujino is celebrated by her classmates for her funny comics in the class newspaper. One day, her teacher asks her to share the space with Kyomoto, a truant recluse whose beautiful artwork sparks a competitive fervor in Fujino. What starts as jealousy transforms when Fujino realizes their shared passion for drawing.

title: If I Go Will They Miss Me
original_title: If I Go Will They Miss Me
overview_en: In Watts, California, a 12-year-old boy attempts to connect with his distant father following his incarceration while sensing mysterious visions, from airplanes and Greek gods, that seem to follow him through his everyday world.

title: Go Team!
tagline: The same f**king team building every year.
overview_en: When their team-building event gets downgraded to a tiny village, a cheese company's staff think it can't get worse — then they learn about the layoffs.

title: Back to Buenos Aires
overview_en: It follows Mariano Guerra as he returns to Argentina to testify against soldiers who tortured him during the dictatorship, focusing not on revenge but on his inner struggle with guilt, trauma, and the lasting psychological impact of violence kept largely off-screen.

title: Gator Face
tagline: Real alligators. Real teeth. Real terror.
overview_en: A Florida vacation becomes a blood-soaked fight for survival when a group of friends are hunted through the swamps by a savage cult that feeds its victims to ravenous alligators in the name of an ancient reptilian god.

title: The Fix
overview_en: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

title: Forgotten Island
overview_en: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

title: The Uprising
overview_en: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.

title: Lion Fist
overview_en: Martial arts fighter Joe goes to prison for four years and takes his wife's blame for a drug bust. After his release, he learns that his son needs expensive surgery because of a life-threatening tumor. Joe's only chance to save him: a brutal all-styles tournament with a $100,000 prize.

title: Bad Apples
overview_en: A struggling primary school teacher is forced to take drastic action because of a foul-mouthed, violent student, and uncovers how her community will turn a blind eye to the most outrageous events to preserve harmony and their sense of safety.
overview_id: Seorang guru sekolah dasar yang sedang kesulitan terpaksa mengambil tindakan drastis karena seorang murid yang bermulut kotor dan kasar, dan mengungkap bagaimana komunitasnya akan menutup mata terhadap peristiwa paling keterlaluan demi menjaga keharmonisan dan rasa aman mereka.

title: Mandaadi
overview_en: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

title: Mum, I'm Alien Pregnant
tagline: Morning sickness is the least of her problems.
overview_en: When a messy underachiever accidentally gets alien-pregnant, she must overcome skeptical doctors, a useless baby daddy, and her oversharing mum in order to survive and reclaim her life.

title: The Echo Chamber
overview_en: Leo and Ava chase each other—coming close, drifting apart, and searching for their way back. They cannot let go, nor break free. Through the rooms, Ava’s voice echoes across time, carrying to the surface what endures—and what can no longer be held back.

title: Practical Magic 2
overview_en: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

title: Drawn Together
overview_en: Marfil, daughter of a powerful Spanish businessman, sees her life in New York turned upside down when she is kidnapped and released without explanation. Her father hires Sebastian Moore as bodyguard and, forced to spend every minute together, an inevitable attraction ignites in a world where nothing is as it seems.
overview_id: Marfil, putri pengusaha Spanyol yang berkuasa, melihat hidupnya berantakan ketika dia diculik dan dilepaskan tanpa penjelasan. Ayahnya merekrut Sebastián Moore sebagai pengawalnya dan, terpaksa menghabiskan setiap menit bersama, ketertarikan tak terelakkan muncul antara mereka di dunia yang tak seperti yang terlihat. Berdasarkan novel karya Mercedes Ron, penulis kisah Culpables.

title: Band of Brothers: Legacy
tagline: The world depended on them. They depended on each other. A look back after 25 years.
overview_en: This tribute to the groundbreaking series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company and deepened public appreciation for the sacrifices of the Greatest Generation features new interviews with cast members Damian Lewis, Ron Livingston, Michael Cudlitz, Capt. Dale Dye, USMC (Ret.), David Schwimmer, and more. Through personal reflections and behind-the-scenes stories, participants revisit the experience of making the series and explore its lasting cultural resonance, and also includes never-before-seen archival footage and photographs of Easy Company and World War II.

title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
original_title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
overview_en: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

title: A Woman's Life
overview_en: Gabrielle, a dedicated surgeon and head of a hospital department, is stretched thin by the weight of responsibility. There is little time left for her private life: a loving husband and a mother who depends on her care. Yet this is the life she wanted, the life she chose. When a novelist comes to observe her at work for a book, her balance begins to shift.

title: The Militia
overview_en: Daniel Pierce dreams of joining the local Militia alongside his father once he turns eighteen, but when his Dad becomes the target of the local Sheriff, Daniel and his friends form their own militia in a troubled effort to save him.

title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
original_title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
overview_en: The couples reunite for the destination wedding of Marcus and Angela's daughter, bringing drama old and new as they ask, "Why did we get married again?"
overview_id: Para pasangan berkumpul kembali dalam pernikahan putri Marcus dan Angela, yang menghadirkan drama lama dan baru saat mereka bertanya, "Mengapa dahulu kita menikah lagi?"

title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool
original_title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool
overview_en: Mr. T took the world by storm as an '80s icon. This documentary reveals the full story behind the mohawk, chains and catchphrase from the man himself.
overview_id: Mr. T menggemparkan dunia sebagai ikon 1980-an. Dokumenter ini mengungkap kisah di balik rambut mohawk, kalung rantai, dan ucapan khasnya langsung dari pria itu sendiri.

title: Stavros Halkias: Uncle Stav
overview_en: In this unruly set, Stavros Halkias imagines becoming a "dirtbag" uncle, roasts the health care system and warns of the risks of living your best life.

title: Runner
overview_en: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Prelude to a Wedding
original_title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Prelude to a Wedding
overview_en: When Gethsemane is invited to play at a wedding, she and Eamon find themselves involved in the death of a member of the bridal party.

title: Resident Dead
overview_en: A man keeping his recently zombified daughter secure in hopes of a cure is tasked with delivering an unknown package through hordes of undead. If he succeeds, he will be given a cure for his daughter. If he fails, or opens the package, they will both be killed.

title: The Incomer
tagline: Welcome to Auk Isle. Population: one too many.
overview_en: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy survive by hunting seabirds, retelling the stories of their ancestors, and defending the isle from dreaded "Incomers". Their world is upended with the arrival of an awkward council worker who has come to uproot them from their homeland.

title: The Girl in the River
overview_en: A seasoned criminologist and a young female psychologist are lured to a remote Mississippi town to investigate the murder of a little girl and the disappearance of her twin sister.

title: Elephants in the Fog
overview_en: In a small Nepalese village nestled in the heart of a forest populated by wild elephants, Pirati is the matriarch of a Kinnar community. She dreams of escaping to a “normal” life with the man she is in love with. But when one of her daughters disappears, she must investigate and choose between love and responsibility to her community.

title: The Runner
tagline: One hour. One chance to save her son.
overview_en: Maia Marten, a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.
overview_id: Dalam film triler psikologis The Runner, Maia Marten, seorang pengacara London yang pintar, merasa hidupnya hancur oleh satu telepon pada lari paginya: putranya diculik. Agar putranya kembali, dia harus terus berlari, mematuhi setiap perintah kejam dan tak memercayai siapa pun - tiap detik adalah ujian sejauh apa seorang ibu akan berjuang untuk menyelamatkan anaknya.

title: Clash of the Thundermans
overview_en: When Chloe develops a destructive new superpower, the Hero League orders her to an elite boarding school for superheroes to learn control of her abilities. Faced with the prospect of sending Chloe away for years, the Thundermans split apart, with Phoebe, Barb and Billy taking her into hiding. Max, Hank, and Nora track their rogue family members, until the two factions face off against each other in a full-on battle for the Thundermans’ future.

title: My Best Friend
overview_en: When empty nest syndrome hits, two BFFs follow their teen daughters to Portugal and find love, fun and a whole new meaning of friendship along the way.

title: Mayday
tagline: A friendship with major red flags.
overview_en: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.
overview_id: Saat seorang pilot Angkatan Laut AS dalam misi rahasia selama Perang Dingin terjebak di belakang garis musuh, satu-satunya peluang untuk bertahan hidup adalah menjalin aliansi dengan seorang mantan agen KGB eksentrik.

title: Gandhari
overview_en: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

title: Mirzapur: The Movie
overview_en: Akhandanand Tripathi sits on the throne of Mirzapur. Munna Tripathi is heir apparent. Rati Shankar Shukla is the rival from Jaunpur. And, Guddu and Bablu are the two brothers who came like a tornado and changed things irreversibly. And now comes a new claimant in town. Babban Babua, from the desert of Jaisalmer. A ruthless man who is power hungry.

title: Fito Páez: The World Within a Song
original_title: Fito Páez: El mundo cabe en una canción
overview_en: A documentary film that observes, listens to, and interacts with Fito Páez from a place of profound intimacy. The camera, almost invisible, witnesses his every move, accompanying him for over a year during recordings, rehearsals, tours, and performances in major cities across Latin America, Europe, and the United States. It is also a journey through the life of one of the greatest Spanish-language artists: his loves and heartbreaks, children and friendships, excesses, tragedies, failures, and successes.

title: Onslaught
tagline: They unleashed their deadliest weapon on us.
overview_en: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

title: By Any Means
tagline: The FBI couldn't crack it. So they called in the mob.
overview_en: In 1960s Mississippi, a young Black FBI agent is forced to partner with a notorious mafia hitman to investigate a wave of brutal civil rights murders.

title: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian
overview_en: The Mandalorian and Grogu join their misfit allies for an epic party, celebrating their heroism. As friends regale the crowd with tales of their adventures, a pirate threat looms.

title: Bucking Fastard
overview_en: Two sisters, Jean and Joan Holbrooke, are so close to each other that they speak in unison, love the same man, and have the same dreams. They even make the same slip of tongue in unison. We cannot see the world as they see it, but we do see how the world reacts to them – through the courts and the press, through those that want to help and those who want to use them, through the eyes of beasts both tame and wild, and even through their own echoes in the core of the earth.

title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11
overview_en: A quarter-century after September 11th, the attacks' ripple effects persist across generations. Orphaned children, War on Terror journalists, young Afghans, and U.S. Marines shaped by the 2021 withdrawal share their stories.

title: The Blow
overview_en: Nineteen-year-old Enzo and his twenty-year-old sister Carla have been left to fend for themselves for several years. When their father, Anthony, is released from prison, Enzo sees the fragile promise of a family to rebuild, unlike Carla, for whom the idea remains inconceivable. Haunted by his past, Enzo must confront a truth he has kept hidden for far too long.

title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
overview_en: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.
overview_id: Dalam pendakian berbahaya melintasi Gunung Kwan di Thailand, dua pendaki terjebak ribuan kaki di atas tanah, di mana ketinggian yang memicu vertigo, paparan yang sangat luas, dan peluang yang mustahil mengubah setiap saat menjadi perjuangan untuk bertahan hidup.

title: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
tagline: Is Raygun a rebel, a villain or an impostor?
overview_en: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.

title: Confinement
overview_en: Pregnant and recently widowed, Stella is taken in by her late husband’s estranged family. But beneath their generosity lies something deeply unsettling, leaving Stella fighting for her life as their obsession with her unborn child turns deadly.

title: Zip Wire
overview_en: When her ground-breaking pharmaceutical discovery is stolen and partner murdered, researcher Amy must face her fear of heights to escape nefarious attackers, with the only path to salvation being a treacherous aerial runway. To outsmart the mysterious hostiles, she has to summon every ounce of courage to protect the world-changing scientific discovery — and herself — before it's too late.

title: Call My Agent! The Movie
overview_en: Five years after ASK Agency closed, debut director Andréa loses her lead actor just days before filming and reunited with her old team — for better or worse.

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview_en: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

title: Just Play Dead
overview_en: A criminal mastermind plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife's lover. His wife plots to kill him for real and take it all. Both race to outmanoeuvre each other in a deadly battle of wits.

title: The Secret Woman
overview_en: After discovering she has a family and a shipping empire, a woman with amnesia returns to a wealthy and seemingly perfect past to uncover why she left.

title: Barreda
tagline: El Asesino Que Dividió A Un País
overview_en: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

title: The Sun Never Sets
overview_en: While on an unexpected break from her older, divorced boyfriend, a woman runs into her ex-partner, plunging her into a volatile love triangle that threatens to undo her life.

title: The Last Scene
overview_en: Selen is a woman with the extraordinary ability to foresee other people’s futures in her dreams. Determined to use this gift to change her own life and the fate of those around her, she unexpectedly finds herself drawn into a dangerous love story. When she crosses paths with a man, Kemal, their connection sparks both passion and peril, forcing Selen to make choices that will shape both of their destinies.

title: Buddy
overview_en: Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy - bright orange unicorn - spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.

title: The Whisper Man
tagline: If you leave a door half open, soon you'll hear the whispers spoken.
overview_en: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.
overview_id: Saat putra kecilnya hilang, seorang duda meminta bantuan ayahnya yang lama terpisah, pensiunan detektif yang menangkap pembunuh berantai yang kini terkait kasus itu.

title: Papi Ricky: La Película
overview_en: Alicia returns to Chile to introduce her future husband, an eccentric young Spanish hipster who embodies modernity. His arrival causes a family upheaval, and the clash with the conservative Papi Ricky and the irreverent Catrala leads both parents to put aside their old differences and unite around a common goal: stopping their daughter’s wedding.

title: Spider Island
tagline: Eight legs, one bite, no chance.
overview_en: A group of social media influencers go to the launch of a new hotel on a tropical island, where they find deadly spiders.

title: Prosecution
overview_en: After surviving a racist attack, state prosecutor Seyo Kim takes her own case to court – confronting both the perpetrators and a justice system that turns a blind eye to right-wing extremism.

title: The Dog Stars
tagline: At the end of the world, no one survives alone.
overview_en: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

title: Tad and The Magic Lamp
original_title: Tadeo Jones y La Lámpara Maravillosa
overview_en: Tadeo, his girlfriend Sara, and his friends Momia, Jeff, and Belzoni embark on an adventure after Tadeo accidentally unleashes an ancient spell.

title: The Last Sunrise
overview_en: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.
overview_id: Berdasarkan novel kesayangan kita, The Last Sunrise menceritakan Ry, mahasiswi dengan penyakit kronis pergi berlibur ke Mallorca bersama ibunya. Saat dia jatuh cinta kepada Julián dan mulai menikmati hidupnya saat ini, penyakitnya makin parah dan rahasia keluarga yang lama terpendam mengungkapkan semuanya sebelum musim panas berakhir.

title: Toxic
overview_en: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

title: Yellow Mirror
overview_en: A defective lamp reveals a heartbreaking truth about what Homer believes is reality, and an AI-powered tablet befriends and controls Maggie. The Simpsons struggle to find the light through two dark tales of the curious and bizarre.

title: The Journey to Gyeong-ju
overview_en: Eight years ago, the youngest daughter, Gyeong-ju, disappeared during a school field trip to Gyeongju and never came home alive. On what would have been her birthday, her mother Ok-sil and her three daughters—Jang-ju, Young-ju, and Dong-ju—put on matching family T-shirts and set off for Gyeongju, the place where Gyeong-ju vanished, in what appears to be a family trip to honor her memory. But beneath the cheerful façade lies a deadly secret. In the trunk of their van is a bound and unconscious man zipped inside a plastic bag.

title: The Unknown
overview_en: David Zimmerman, almost 40, is a photographer but no one knows it. When friends drag him to a wild party, he spots a woman in the crowd and can’t take his eyes off her, he follows her… A few hours later, David wakes up: he’s in the body of the unknown woman.

title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
original_title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
overview_en: After delivering one of the greatest performances in Rose Bowl history, Texas Longhorns legend Vince Young was the NFL's next big thing, and for a while, he was. But a career riddled by injuries, conflict and sudden loss tells a far more complicated story than the highlight reels ever showed.

title: Facing El Chapo
overview_en: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

title: It Ends
overview_en: A group of recent grads head out on a late night drive for grub, hoping to enjoy one final hangout before their paths diverge. Instead, they accidentally turn onto a never-ending, two-lane hellscape surrounded by untold horrors and cosmic forces beyond their understanding. Cramped together inside a Jeep Cherokee and with the miles stretching infinitely ahead, they face a choice: embrace their new existence or fight to escape it.

title: Hot Spot
overview_en: Set in a near future society ruled by sentient A.I., a private eye investigates a murder case only to discover a rebel group capable of undermining the digital overlord. As the detective's identity slowly unravels, his world enters a state of hypnotic meltdown.

title: Modha Rathri
overview_en: Two strangers are brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

title: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem
overview_en: During a heavy rainstorm, the Princess characters and their sidekick friends take in animals in need while enjoying a cozy day in their castle. But when the animals run amok, chaos erupts. Sleuthing reveals a mischievous villain behind it all, and with teamwork, quick thinking, and help from an unexpected friend, the Princess characters must restore order and save their home.

title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
overview_en: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

title: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
overview_en: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.

title: Coyote vs. Acme
tagline: The movie ACME doesn't want you to see.
overview_en: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

title: Idiots
overview_en: Two rock-bottom drivers transport a wealthy teen to rehab, but their simple job spirals into a chaotic journey of drugs, danger, and crime as their passenger derails their plans.

title: Irumudi
overview_en: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

title: Spa Weekend
overview_en: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.

title: Khalifa: The Ruler
tagline: Vengeance will be written in gold.
overview_en: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
original_title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
overview_en: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.
overview_id: Semua gelar tenis telah ditaklukkan, termasuk emas Olimpiade. Lalu apa yang masih dikejar? The Wolf in Winter mengikuti legenda tenis, Novak Djokovic, di Australia Terbuka 2025, mengungkap obsesi, persiapan, dan semangat yang tetap membara meski tak ada lagi yang perlu dibuktikan.

title: Chompoo: Lost​ &​ Forgotten​
original_title: คดีชมพู่:​ เด็กหายที่ถูกลืม
tagline: The suspect who became a celebrity?
overview_en: When a young girl vanishes from a remote village, the frantic police hunt become a media frenzy. But who turned a suspected criminal into a celebrity?

title: Insidious: Out of the Further
overview_en: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

title: Mutiny
overview_en: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

title: V
overview_en: In the early 1990s, this city of desire, once a land of opportunity, was plagued by rampant crime and a breakdown of order. Man Tsz-keung, a working-class man desperate to change his fate, meets flight attendant Lok Ka-yuen, and the two team up to rob a large sum of money. This success fuels Man Tsz-keung's madness, pushing him into a deeper power struggle with wealthy businessman Chan Fai-yin. Meanwhile, mainland police officer Qi Honggang and Hong Kong police officer Guan Suchen continue their investigation of Wan Ziqiang, leading to a joint operation between the two police forces, setting the stage for a clash between good and evil. This film is fictional.

title: Back to the 90s
overview_en: When a mysterious glitch sends a rising boyband back to 1995 - just days before the biggest showcase of their lives - the five friends race to reverse the time slip. But as unexpected connections form and the past pulls them in deeper, getting home means confronting what they're willing to leave behind - and who they truly are to each other.

title: Vishwanath & Sons
overview_en: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

title: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
original_title: Mein bester Freund, seine Freundin und ich
overview_en: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.

title: The Wrong Girls
overview_en: Two codependent best friends living paycheck to paycheck and bong rip to bong rip get caught in a case of mistaken identity that throws their lives into chaos.

title: American Doctor
overview_en: United by a shared oath to save lives, three American doctors—Palestinian, Jewish, and Zoroastrian—work in a besieged hospital in Gaza in the middle of a genocide comitted by Israel, and return to the United States to fight for the patients and colleagues they left behind.

title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
overview_en: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

title: Union County
tagline: For two brothers, recovery is just the beginning.
overview_en: Assigned to a county-mandated drug court program, Cody Parsons embarks on the tenuous journey toward recovery amid the opioid epidemic in rural Ohio.

title: All Night Wrong
