overview_en: Gary and Ell (a married man with an inferiority complex, and a grieving young widow) meet on a blind date only to wind up stealing a killer's car along with a dead body and $40,000.

title: The Rivals of Amziah King
tagline: Ain’t no one all bad or all good.
overview_en: Deep within the backwoods of rural Oklahoma, charismatic and musically gifted Amziah King herds a bluegrass-playing band of misfits while overseeing the premier honey-making operation in town. When Amziah’s estranged foster daughter unexpectedly returns, Amziah leaps at the possibility to renew connection and create a family business. But the honey game is ruthless, and Amziah’s rivals threaten to destroy everything he has built.

title: Don't Say Good Luck
overview_en: Sophie Birenbaum is ready for the spotlight as the lead in her high school musical—until she's suddenly facing more drama at home than on the stage.
overview_id: Sebagai pemeran utama, Sophie Birenbaum siap menjadi pusat perhatian dalam drama musikal di sekolahnya—sampai drama di rumah tiba-tiba lebih besar daripada di panggung.

title: Camp Rock 3
overview_en: When pop group Connect 3 returns to Camp Rock to search for an opening act for their reunion tour, rising tensions and fierce competition among campers test old friendships and spark unexpected romances.

title: The Brink of War
tagline: Not all battles are fought with bullets.
overview_en: President Ronald Reagan races against time to salvage a deal with Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev that could dismantle nuclear arsenals—or ignite disaster. With pressure mounting on all sides, every word spoken brings the world closer to peace... or destruction.

title: The End of Oak Street
overview_en: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

title: Sacrifice
overview_en: At a glitzy Greek island charity gala, a down-on-his-luck movie star lands the heroic role of a lifetime when a volcanic doomsday cult takes him hostage.

title: Sunny Dancer
overview_en: Reluctantly sent to a summer retreat for young cancer survivors, a teenager in remission unexpectedly finds deep connections and new beginnings among fellow campers.

title: Nando Between Two Worlds - A Sintonia Film
original_title: Nando Entre Dois Mundos: Um Filme Sintonia
overview_en: Caught between family life and his obligations to the criminal underworld, Nando faces an impossible choice about where his true loyalties lie.

title: Un grand raccourci
overview_en: When their family restaurant is on the verge of closing, two cousins release rats in an attempt to set themselves up as pest control experts. That same summer, two young women rig the local beauty contest to promote their jewelry. Caught up in their chaotic schemes, these four resourceful young people searching for a better future eventually cross paths.

title: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
overview_en: Seeking a fresh start, chef Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to support his family and repay his debts. Alongside restaurant manager Ma Junsheng, he transforms the struggling Dragon Restaurant into a thriving business. But when war engulfs the city, their hard-won success is shattered and the restaurant becomes a refuge for those caught in the conflict. As danger closes in, Xu Fu must risk everything to protect his newfound community and preserve a small beacon of hope amid the devastation.

title: Tony
tagline: "I was — to be frank — a spoiled, miserable, narcissistic, self-destructive and thoughtless young lout, and badly in need of a good ass-kicking."
overview_en: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

title: THE RIBBON HERO
original_title: THE RIBBON HERO リボンヒーロー
overview_en: When the monstrous Nergal devastates her kingdom, Princess Sapphire reawakens as the Ribbon Hero and fights to save her new home from the same dark fate.
overview_id: Saat monster Nergal menghancurkan kerajaannya, Putri Sapphire bangkit sebagai The Ribbon Hero dan berjuang menyelamatkan rumah barunya dari nasib tragis yang sama.

title: Hanuman Ansh
tagline: Jinke kaam mein seva, jinke bhav mein bhakti, aur jinke hriday mein Sita Ram.
overview_en: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.

title: Late Fame
overview_en: At the very end of the 1970s, post office worker Ed Saxberger wrote a book of poetry that nobody cared about. After an eager and flattering fan appears on his doorstep, Saxberger is beckoned into a coterie of young admirers who anoint him a rediscovered genius. The group of downtown bohemians is led by their "tragic heroine," Gloria. Intoxicated by the attention, and Gloria's alluring presence, Saxberger gradually reckons with the authenticity of his newfound poetic circle.

title: Love is Love
overview_en: Enrique Juarez is an up-and-coming Mexican Telenovela actor on the verge of becoming a leading man, that has to hide his true self in order to achieve stardom.

title: Feed
tagline: Witness the first of her kind
overview_en: Five social media influencers spend a weekend at a forest retreat but inadvertently awaken and confront the world's first vampire.

title: Rage of Stars
overview_en: A story about a woman from the International Special Forces Unit, who has a premonition about the impending end of humanity.

title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
original_title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
overview_en: An ambitious director sets out to revive a faded slasher franchise, but her meeting with the film’s reclusive original star spirals into a terrifying maze of obsession, fear, and blood-soaked delusion.

title: The Last House
overview_en: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.
overview_id: Tiba-tiba terkurung di dalam rumah, keluarga ini harus bekerja sama untuk bertahan hidup saat persediaan makanan menipis dan kekuatan jahat membuat mereka terperangkap.

title: One Night Only
overview_en: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

title: Super Troopers 3
overview_en: When Farva’s wildly over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny’s sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny’s schemes to break up the relationship, while trying to crack a pernicious new drug ring — all to save the day and maybe the wedding itself.

title: DC
overview_en: From avenging his mother’s murder to battling police corruption, Das becomes a fugitive after a deadly heist. Amid a trail of bloodshed and loss, he frees Chandra from a life of exploitation, and she gives him a reason to seek a life beyond violence.

title: Everytime
overview_en: A tragedy brings a mother, daughter, and teenage boy together. Struggling with blame and forgiveness, the unlikely trio take a trip to Tenerife for a family holiday that never happened. Under the glow of the sun, past and present quietly start to overlap.

title: Nimrods
overview_en: Three friends journey from Kansas City to Los Angeles, mistakenly believing that their band is opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve.

title: The Last Warrior: Kolobok
overview_en: Kolobok decides to change his fate and unwittingly becomes the partner of the humble baker Tikhon.

title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
original_title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
overview_en: In a bold 28-day experiment, comedian Mo Gilligan tours the UK and US on a fried chicken diet to uncover the impact of the craving — and industry behind it.

title: Niu Lai
overview_en: The naive calf Niu Lai loves exploring the grasslands, but struggles to live up to his family’s expectations as future leader of the herd. With migration fast approaching, Niu Lai finds unlikely allies on his journey to learn the meaning of courage as they prepare for a dangerous trek across the desert.

title: Inside the Trustor Scandal
overview_en: For the first time since 1997, Joachim Posener finally emerges from hiding and allows himself to be interviewed about his life and the Trustor affair. Twenty-seven years ago, he disappeared without a trace, and ever since, he has been on the international most wanted list. Now, Karin af Klintberg searches for him to find out how he lives and where he's been hiding all these years. But perhaps above all, to uncover what everyone is wondering: Was he guilty? Through new and opposing testimonies from never-before-heard voices, Karin simultaneously continues the search for the truth about the coup. How could five people swindle 600 million kr and still go free? And where did the money actually go?

title: Ice Cream Man
overview_en: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

title: Storm on Sesame Street
overview_en: As a big storm approaches, Elmo and friends work together to get ready. After it passes, Sesame Street looks different — and everyone pitches in to help.

title: WWE SummerSlam 2026: Sunday
tagline: SETH ROLLINS. ROMAN REIGNS. ONE LAST DANCE.
overview_en: The 2026 SummerSlam, also promoted as SummerSlam: Minnesota, is a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It is the 39th annual SummerSlam and took place as a two-night event on August 1st and 2nd at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

title: How to Lose a Popularity Contest
original_title: How to Lose a Popularity Contest
overview_en: A rebellious student and a perfectionist overachiever form an unlikely alliance in their race for student body president, discovering unexpected feelings along the way.

title: WWE SummerSlam 2026: Saturday
tagline: THE RULER. THE BEAST. HELL IN A CELL.
overview_en: The 2026 SummerSlam, also promoted as SummerSlam: Minnesota, is a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It is the 39th annual SummerSlam and took place as a two-night event on August 1st and 2nd at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

title: Soulm8te
tagline: You can't turn off the power of love.
overview_en: After a ruthless tech giant acquires a small robotics company, a grieving engineer is tasked with testing their new AI companion. But when he attempts to reprogram her to be a truly sentient soulmate, she develops needs of her own—unleashing a relentless spree of precision-engineered mayhem.

title: The Gentleman Thief
overview_en: A retired master thief must protect his impulsive brother from disaster when a 100 million dollar yacht heist spirals into a dangerous web of deception. Old foes emerge as the stakes rise, forcing him to use every trick he knows to stay alive.

title: Unmadham
overview_en: Haunted by his past, a police constable reopens an unsolved cold case. As hidden secrets surface, he must confront truths that challenge his beliefs forever.

title: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
original_title: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
overview_en: When Snoopy's beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.
overview_id: Ketika rumah kesayangan Snoopy menghilang, ia mencoba melacaknya, dan menyadari apa yang membuat suatu tempat menjadi rumah.

title: A Child of My Own
overview_en: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
tagline: A brand new day starts now.
overview_en: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.
overview_id: Empat tahun setelah peristiwa Spider-Man: No Way Home, Peter Parker sudah tidak ada lagi dan Spider-Man kini berada di puncak kemampuannya dalam menjaga Kota New York tetap aman. Semuanya berjalan dengan baik hingga serangkaian kejahatan yang tidak biasa menyeret Spider-Man ke dalam jaring misteri yang lebih besar dari apa pun yang pernah ia hadapi sebelumnya. Untuk menghadapi apa yang akan datang, Spider-Man tidak hanya harus berada dalam kondisi fisik dan mental terbaiknya, tetapi juga harus siap menghadapi konsekuensi dari masa lalunya!

title: I Want Your Sex
overview_en: When a naive young man becomes the sexual muse for a renowned and provocative artist, his dream job quickly turns dangerous as he is drawn into an obsessive world of power, betrayal, and murder.

title: Above & Below
overview_en: A group of friends' dream diving vacation turns into a fight for survival when brutal criminals attack their boat in open waters.

title: The Devil's Mouth
overview_en: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.
overview_id: Lima orang teman menjelajahi sistem gua Devil's Mouth di Thailand untuk satu petualangan terakhir sebelum memasuki dunia kerja. Namun, mereka menemukan suatu makhluk yang memburu mereka di bawah air... Cepat, senyap, dan mematikan. Dalam kegelapan menyesakkan, kepercayaan hancur, kepanikan menyebar, dan tiap kesalahan memaksa mereka berjuang bertahan hidup.

title: Madame
overview_en: To make ends meet, Laura takes a job working for Souria in a grand mansion in Paris’s Golden Triangle. Installed there by her lover, a wealthy Saudi prince, Souria lives in anticipation of his visits. As Laura struggles to adjust to this world of excessive luxury and constant surveillance, a fragile bond begins to form between the two women. But Laura senses that Souria is in danger, and that this gilded cage may be closing in on them both.

title: Marvelous Mornings
overview_en: At her grandmother's funeral, Charlie learns that she already has a place reserved in the family vault. In search of an escape, she herself delivers the crate of disco vinyls her grandmother left to the wine merchant in a village in the south of France. In the deserted seaside resort, the records bring back bitter memories of lost loves. Here, time has a different value, and people are more bored than busy. Charlie only has eyes for Marina, the waitress at the pizzeria. Nothing predestined clumsy, overly sincere Charlie and wounded tornado Marina to mend fences together. But sometimes destiny reunites lost mermaids.

title: Crazy Magical Mexico
overview_en: A man finds the best motivation to secure and save his town: making an independent Mexican film.

title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
overview_en: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.

title: Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of the Mermaid Island
original_title: 映画ちいかわ 人魚の島のひみつ
overview_en: Chiikawa and friends set off on a whimsical summer adventure to a mysterious island said to hide a long-lost mermaid secret. What starts as a fun getaway quickly turns into a heartwarming journey filled with surprises, gentle thrills, and adorable chaos. With sparkling seas, strange legends, and unforgettable encounters, the trio learns about courage, friendship, and the magic hidden in small moments.
overview_id: Chiikawa, Hachiware, dan Usagi memulai petualangan musim panas yang unik ke sebuah pulau misterius yang konon menyembunyikan rahasia putri duyung yang telah lama hilang. Apa yang awalnya hanya liburan menyenangkan dengan cepat berubah menjadi perjalanan yang mengharukan penuh kejutan, menegangkan, dan penuh kekacauan yang menggemaskan. Dengan laut yang berkilauan, legenda aneh, dan pertemuan yang tak terlupakan, Chiikawa belajar tentang keberanian, persahabatan, dan keajaiban yang tersembunyi dalam momen-momen kecil. Rahasia Pulau Putri Duyung akan segera terungkap...

title: The Truthers
overview_en: After her mother's sudden death, Ruth returns to her hometown and reunites with her father, whose odd behavior makes her question what really happened.

title: Euphoria: A Look Back
overview_en: The cast and crew of HBO's Euphoria take an exclusive look back at the critically acclaimed series' origins, evolution, and influences.

title: The Outer Threat
overview_en: After making a groundbreaking extraterrestrial discovery, astrophysicists Daniel and Michelle are forced to flee from home with their family — pursued through the countryside by a relentless and anonymous assailant. As their flight unfolds, the line between cosmic revelation and human paranoia blurs, leading to a tense and emotional confrontation that challenges the boundaries of understanding, science, and survival.

title: Make Zhonghe Great Again
overview_en: After encountering a standout colleague from a company event, Liu Ben, a section chief at Zhonghe Group's branch, embarks on a quirky professional journey with him, uncovering their true self-worth through chaotic workplace challenges.

title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
overview_en: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

title: Motor City
overview_en: In 1970s Detroit, John Miller falls for a local gangster's girl and lands in prison for a crime he didn't commit. With his life ruined, Miller plots revenge against the man who took his girl away.

title: Until the End of the World
overview_en: Manuel's life is upended when Esmeralda, his lost love from 15 years ago, calls unexpectedly. Despite being set to marry another, he rediscovers Esmeralda, and they realize their love transcends time.

title: Her Private Hell
overview_en: When a mysterious mist engulfs a futuristic metropolis, unleashing a deadly and elusive entity, a troubled young woman searches for her father. Her quest collides with an American GI on a harrowing odyssey to rescue his daughter from Hell.

title: The Dink
overview_en: Desperate to save a struggling country club and earn his father's respect, a washed-up tennis pro is compelled to break a sacred vow and do the unthinkable: play pickleball.
overview_id: Dusty “Sang Hammer” Boyd, mantan petenis profesional yang kariernya telah merosot, membutuhkan kemenangan. Demi menyelamatkan klub tenis yang sedang kesulitan dan mendapatkan kembali rasa hormat ayahnya, Dusty melanggar sumpah suci dan melakukan hal yang tak terduga, dia bermain pickleball.

title: Love in Slow Motion
overview_en: When Haya's best friend Jawad gets engaged, her chronically-single world unravels — because who knew true love could be hiding in the friend zone?

title: Penny Lane Is Dead
overview_en: Set in 1986, during a scorching Aussie summer, three best friends' celebration at a beach house turns into a blood-soaked fight for survival when a prank goes horribly wrong.

title: Pinocchio: Unstrung
tagline: He has no strings to hold him back now.
overview_en: Influenced by a sinister Cricket and created by Geppetto, Pinocchio launches a violent crusade to carve himself into a real boy like his brother James, one piece at a time.

title: Elize: Shadows of a Woman
tagline: The truth behind a perfect marriage.
overview_en: In this retelling of a real case, a former escort discovers her wealthy husband's infidelity and struggles to cope as betrayal poisons their marriage.

title: Jana Nayagan
overview_en: A clash of ideologies. One stands for the people, the other feeds on control. Their paths collided once before. Years later, a child’s silent fear ignites the past, drawing a former police officer into a battle far bigger than personal revenge.

title: Ip Man: Kung Fu Legend
overview_en: In 1950s Hong Kong, British merchants and Chinese triads have joined forces to expand their territory, forcibly demolishing factories without regard for public welfare. This move draws fierce opposition from Ip Man, standing up for the workers, he faces pressure from all sides. Framed for murder, he is sent to prison. Within the prison walls, the triads set multiple deadly traps. Can Ip Man overcome these trials, escape the danger, and clear his name?
overview_id: Berlatar belakang masa muda Ip Man sebelum ia menjadi guru besar yang legendaris, film ini mengisahkan perjuangannya dalam menyempurnakan teknik Wing Chun sambil menghadapi tekanan dari sekolah-sekolah bela diri saingan dan ancaman dari pihak asing yang mencoba menguasai wilayahnya. Di tengah konflik fisik dan batin, Ip Man harus membuktikan bahwa kekuatan sejati bukan hanya berasal dari kepalan tangan, melainkan dari keteguhan prinsip dan kerendahan hati.

title: A Toxic Love Story
overview_en: A string of threatening emails escalates into a revenge plot involving a newly married US marshal and his ex-girlfriend.

title: Comédie-Française
overview_en: At the Comédie-Française, there is one golden rule: the play is never canceled. Unfortunately for Nina, everything else is—just three hours before the premiere of her first staging. An actor is stuck on a train, tensions explode, equipment breaks down, egos clash, and panic sets in. With no way out and time slipping away, Nina must hold the show together at all costs. Will she make it until the curtain rises?

title: The Debt Collector
original_title: คนเดือดทวงแค้น
tagline: A debt can be settled, but not erased.
overview_en: Tormented by past mistakes and a terminal diagnosis, an ex-debt collector returns to the underworld to protect the victims of a violent organization.

title: 72 HOURS
tagline: The night is young. He isn't.
overview_en: To save his career, a 40-year-old ad exec joins a crew of twentysomethings for a wild Miami bachelor party after they mistakenly add him to a group chat.
overview_id: Setelah tak sengaja ditambahkan ke obrolan grup pria berusia 20-an, eksekutif periklanan berusia 40 tahun ini terpaksa ikut pesta bujang liar di Miami demi kariernya.

title: Water Park Shark
tagline: No food in the pool. Except you.
overview_en: Sharks breach a seaside water park during the debut of a new ride, forcing a lifeguard and the town’s police chief to contain the chaos and protect guests from becoming prey.

title: Borderline
overview_en: Convinced they are our secret saviors, rogue U.S. operatives abduct Mexican gang members and seed them across major American cities, unleashing criminal chaos, swaying voters by playing on nativist prejudices, and forcing law enforcement into a race to expose the plot as the escalating carnage threatens democracy itself.

title: Ni contigo ni sin mí
overview_en: Ernesto's wife has just left him. He decides to spend his birthday at his beach house with his best friend, only to discover that his ex-wife is now his neighbour's new girlfriend.

title: Descendants: Wicked Wonderland
overview_en: Now that the Queen of Hearts is nice and Cinderella is safe, things seem perfect for Red and Chloe… But little do they know that changing the past created a new villain — Maddox Hatter. When Maddox captures the Queen of Hearts, Red and Chloe must work alongside Red’s new sister Pink, Luisa Madrigal’s son Luis, and Maddox’s son Max to save her and Wonderland.

title: Grizzly Night
overview_en: On August 12, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happened: that same night, nine miles apart, there were not one—but two—fatal grizzly bear attacks.

title: The Odyssey
overview_en: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.
overview_id: Odysseus, raja legendaris Yunani dari Ithaca, memulai perjalanan panjang dan berbahaya untuk pulang setelah Perang Troya, yang mengisahkan perjumpaannya dengan makhluk-makhluk mitologis seperti Cyclops Polyphemus, para Siren, dan penyihir-dewi Circe.

title: Hope
overview_en: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.
overview_id: Sebuah penemuan misterius terjadi di pinggiran kota pelabuhan kecil. Para penduduk mendapati diri mereka dalam kondisi perjuangan putus asa untuk bertahan hidup melawan sesuatu yang belum pernah mereka temui sebelumnya.

title: The Dreamed Adventure
overview_en: Journeying home to the Bulgarian hinterlands on the border of Turkey and Greece, Saïd seeks out a fuel-smuggling deal with a small-time crook, attracting the attention of Iliya, the local kingpin. Sensing danger, Saïd enlists the help of one-time romantic interest Veska, an archaeologist who years earlier had fallen in with the swindlers and operators of the post-Communist era. But when Saïd goes missing, Veska takes over the smuggling operation, deftly moving among the thunderous, posturing men and coming-face-to-face with the underworld that shaped her past.

title: Heartstopper Forever
overview_en: It's a new school year for the Truham-Higgs gang. As Nick and Charlie's relationship deepens, their thoughts turn to life after the last bell rings.
overview_id: Tahun sekolah yang baru untuk geng Truham-Higgs datang. Saat hubungan Nick dan Charlie bertambah dalam, pikiran mereka beralih ke kehidupan setelah bel terakhir berbunyi.

title: The Odyssey: The Making of an Epic
original_title: The Odyssey: The Making of an Epic
overview_en: Go behind the scenes of Christopher Nolan's mythic action epic, The Odyssey. This special documentary explores the monumental undertaking of adapting Homer’s foundational saga for the big screen, charting a grueling 91-day principal photography schedule across six countries. From the revolutionary use of brand-new IMAX film technology to the massive coordination of over 5,300 custom-designed costumes, discover how a star-studded cast led by Matt Damon, Tom Holland, and Anne Hathaway brought the dangerous, timeless world of ancient Greek gods and monsters to life.

title: Kung Fu Soccer
tagline: One kick can ignite the world.
overview_en: Dismissed as underdogs before they even step onto the pitch, the Emei Women's Football Team enters the prestigious Supreme Invincible Cup determined to prove everyone wrong. Led by captain Shuangshuang, star striker Yulong, and mentor Xu Feng, the team combines martial arts mastery with football skill in a thrilling quest for victory. Against mounting challenges and impossible odds, they fight to make their mark and chase their championship dream.

title: Me Before Me
overview_en: A young student battling pressure, panic and a demanding father uses a class project to discover that truth — not trophies — might finally set him free.

title: The Isolate Thief
tagline: Underestimating her is a grave mistake.
overview_en: One bitter-cold winter during the Civil War, a young woman becomes the lone caretaker of a remote Union Army outpost. When a stash of stolen gold falls into her lap, a gang of vicious outlaws comes looking for it. As they turn her home into a battleground, she must stay one step ahead of them in order to survive.

title: All Wishes Come True!
overview_en: Eight grassroot mortals use their street smarts and hilarious schemes to defy powerful gods, earning their title as the Eight Immortals.

title: Dhamaal 4
overview_en: The Dhamaal boys are back for another treasure hunt, facing hilarious challenges in their quest for the Treasure of Life.

title: Haciendo amigos
overview_en: Antonio and Félix, small-time thieves fleeing police after a jewelry heist, meet Eva, a theater group monitor. She mistakes Félix for Ángel, a new member. They use the confusion to hide, unaware they'll spend a week with the group.

title: Idhayam Murali
overview_en: A young man navigates the complexities of unrequited love, finding that even as years pass and life takes unexpected turns, certain emotions remain deeply embedded in his heart.

title: Ikka
tagline: Some trials don't end in court.
overview_en: With a loved one's life at stake, a celebrated lawyer must defend a man he suspects is guilty — battling his conscience every step of the way.

title: Night Nurse
overview_en: As a series of perverse scam calls unsettles an idyllic retirement community, a starry-eyed nurse becomes entangled with her mysterious patient.

title: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea
overview_en: Never-before-seen footage and survivor accounts trace the 2012 shipwreck of a luxury cruise and the disaster that ensued, in this immersive documentary.

title: Miguel Ángel Blanco: The 48 Hours That Changed Spain
original_title: Miguel Ángel Blanco: Las 48 horas que lo cambiaron todo
overview_en: This documentary explores how Miguel Ángel Blanco's 1997 abduction turned fear into collective resistance and shaped Spain's fright Against ETA terrorism.

title: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
original_title: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
tagline: It's hammer time... who's your celebrity sex pass?
overview_en: After her fiance sleeps with his celebrity crush, Kansas hairdresser Gail heads to Hollywood to even the score with her own famous fantasy — Jon Hamm.

title: Infiltrate
overview_en: In a city overrun by crime, government Agent Lily Chen is forced to choose between her duty and her family when her husband is kidnapped, and she’s blackmailed into assassinating high-level criminals to save him. As she delves deeper into the criminal underworld, Lily’s relentless pursuit of justice unravels a web of corruption, leading to a final, life-altering decision that will change her world forever.

title: Moana
tagline: The ocean chose her for a reason.
overview_en: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

title: Nothing to Lose
overview_en: She gave everything to become a mother, so when her young son falls ill, Jada will stop at nothing to find a donor and save him — no matter the cost.

title: Evil Dead Burn
overview_en: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed on fear, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life survive even in death.
overview_id: Setelah kematian suaminya yang mendadak, Alice mencari penghiburan di antara keluarga yang tersisa—keturunan seorang peneliti terkemuka tentang kerasukan setan. Saat mertuanya berubah satu per satu menjadi makhluk yang memakan rasa takut, ia menyadari bahwa sumpah yang diucapkannya semasa hidup tetap berlaku bahkan setelah kematian.

title: Marave
overview_en: It follows Manolo, a gentle, naive fairground worker. When their father gets sick, Manolo reunites with his older brother Georges, a con man who abandoned the family twenty years ago. Desperate to prove he is not a failure, Georges schemes to turn the physically strong Manolo into an MMA (Mixed Martial Arts) champion.

title: One Piece Heroines
overview_en: After failing to stop the thieves due to ill-fitting shoes, Nami storms into the shop where she bought them for a refund. However, the head designer offers to make her a new pair from scratch on one condition: she must walk in their upcoming fashion show.

title: Hammerhead Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
original_title: Hammerhead Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
overview_en: In Mexico’s Pacific waters, Bertie Gregory goes in search of one of the ocean’s most iconic predators: the hammerhead shark. Once abundant in these seas, hammerhead numbers have plummeted, making sightings increasingly rare. Bertie investigates what’s driving the hammerhead decline, and how protected waters offer hope for the future. His journey culminates in a rare and unforgettable encounter that shines a light on the future of one of the world’s most famous sharks.

title: The Odyssey
tagline: The most epic voyage of all time!
overview_en: Based on the Ancient Greek epic. After ten years of war, King Odysseus sets sail for Ithaca, eager to reunite with his beloved. But his journey home is far more treacherous than the battlefield, as he must face deadly monsters and vengeful gods to survive.

title: Night of the Living Dead
overview_en: A ragtag group barricade themselves in an old Pennsylvania farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls ravaging the Northeast.

title: Gatta Kusthi 2
overview_en: Picks up after the first film, with Veera and Keerthi balancing parenthood and Keerthi's wrestling career, featuring a role reversal where Veera takes on more domestic responsibilities.

title: Man of War
overview_en: When an aid worker vanishes in the first hours of war in Ukraine, a former Navy SEAL and CIA operative crosses into the shattered country to bring her home-facing mercenaries, shifting battle lines, and ghosts he thought he left behind.

title: Satluj
tagline: One man's search for truth exposes thousands of buried secrets.
overview_en: Triggered by the search for his missing aunt, human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra takes on a broken system in a courageous fight to uncover the conspiracy behind thousands of disappearances and extrajudicial killings during the nadir of Punjab’s period of insurgency.

title: Simpsley
overview_en: When penniless con-artist Marge Bouvier is sent to Italy to convince wealthy sap Seymour Skinner to come home, she's tempted by the trappings of his affluent lifestyle. But there’s a big fat fly in the ointment: Skinner's clingy, dim-witted mooch of a houseguest, Homer Simpsley. Lies, lust and Italian lira are abound.

title: Summer's Last Resort
overview_en: Determined to save her mom from another bad relationship, a teen accidentally turns a luxury vacation into total chaos.

title: Young Washington
tagline: 250 years of history begins with one man.
overview_en: Before he led a nation, George Washington was a young soldier thrown into a global conflict. With alliances crumbling and war closing in, he must choose who to trust and confront the leader he's becoming.

title: Alpha
overview_en: When Sita, a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, discovers the dark truth about her family and her stolen childhood, she teams up with her long lost sister to take down her creator and his illicit military program.

title: The Bay
overview_en: Best friends Emma and Lani, attending a destination wedding in Thailand, find themselves trapped on a sinking tour boat in the heart of a tiger shark sanctuary.

title: 23 000 Lives
overview_en: A group of young people sets sail for the Mediterranean to save the lives of refugees — a mission that puts their ideas of law and justice to the test.
overview_id: Sekelompok orang yang masih muda berlayar ke Mediterania untuk menyelamatkan nyawa para pengungsi—misi yang menguji pemikiran mereka tentang hukum dan keadilan.

title: Lockbox
overview_en: A woman puts her life on the line to protect her troubled and enigmatic cousin, who has been targeted and hunted by a powerful supernatural force.

title: Rao Bahadur
overview_en: Plagued by guilt and fear, an eccentric aristocrat retreats into his ancestral manor, creating an alternate world that deeply blurs reality and imagination.

title: Nightborn
overview_en: In Finnish forest, Saga and her husband Jon embark on a new chapter as parents. But Saga's joy is overshadowed by a chilling suspicion about their newborn, unbeknownst to Jon, causing a rift as she alone grapples with the disturbing truth.

title: Flies
overview_en: Olga lives a strictly regulated life without attachments in a vast apartment block. When out of financial necessity she rents a room in her apartment to a man who also sneaks-in his nine-year-old son, an unlikely bond forms. Her carefully controlled world begins to shift, and their lives become intertwined against her will.

title: In Waves
tagline: Like a storm, grief comes in waves.
overview_en: In Los Angeles, shy teenager AJ meets Kristen, who lives for surfing; he loves skateboarding and drawing. They fall madly in love, and a happy future seems within reach. But everything changes when Kristen faces a sudden illness. Together, they face adversity, driven by the strength of their love, their friends, and their newly shared passion for surfing and the ocean.

title: Enola Holmes 3
overview_en: Adventure follows detective Enola Holmes to Malta, where her plans to tie the knot unravel when Sherlock's disappearance plunges her into a perilous case.
overview_id: Petualangan mengikuti detektif Enola Holmes ke Malta. Di sana, rencananya pernikahannya kacau setelah hilangnya Sherlock menjerumuskan Enola ke dalam kasus berbahaya.

title: Louis C.K.: Ridiculous
overview_en: From a bee getting shot in New York City to paying strangers to take his aging father, Louis C.K. unleashes the ridiculous thoughts in his mind.

title: WWE Night of Champions 2026
tagline: WITH IT ALL ON THE LINE.
overview_en: The 2026 Night of Champions, also promoted as Night of Champions: Riyadh, was a professional wrestling premium live event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) that took place on June 27, 2026, at Kingdom Arena in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The event featured the finals of the 2026 King and Queen of the Ring tournaments, along with championship matches for the WWE United States Championship and WWE Women's United States Championship. It was headlined by an Undisputed WWE Championship Triple Threat match between champion Cody Rhodes, Sami Zayn, and Gunther.

title: Lucky Strike
overview_en: A wounded American soldier fights to survive behind enemy lines during WWII's Battle of the Bulge against the Germans, relying on his instinct, spy craft and a hand-radio to evade capture and find his way back to his unit.

title: De Gaulle: Liberté
original_title: La Bataille de Gaulle : J'écris ton nom
overview_en: While World War II is raging, General De Gaulle seeks to convince the world that the battle for France not lost. Reality seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

title: The Reality Experiment
tagline: Reality is not what it seems
overview_en: Eight strangers gather for an unknown experiment at the University for a quick payday. However, things rapidly get out of control as reality itself begins to turn on them.

title: The Invite
overview_en: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?

title: Jackass: Best and Last
overview_en: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.

title: Black Box
overview_en: Vero Airlines Flight 298 from New Orleans to Seattle becomes the center of a chilling supernatural mystery.

title: Welcome To The Jungle
tagline: Fake film. Real jungle. Real danger. Real idiots!
overview_en: A group of quirky characters gets stuck in a dangerous jungle during a chaotic mission. Filled with confusion, criminals, and hilarious situations, they must work together to survive and find their way out.

title: Minions & Monsters
overview_en: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

title: Supergirl
overview_en: When an unexpected and ruthless adversary strikes too close to home, Kara Zor-El, aka Supergirl, reluctantly joins forces with an unlikely companion on an epic, interstellar journey of vengeance and justice.

title: The Eyes
tagline: The less she sees, the closer it gets.
overview_en: Seo-jin, a renowned photographer, is shattered by the sudden and mysterious death of her twin sister and sets out to uncover the truth. As her investigation deepens, an unseen presence begins to close in, twisting reality and driving her into a spiral of paranoia as her vision fades away. Now trapped in encroaching darkness, Seo-jin faces a terrifying revelation that shatters everything she thought she knew.

title: Les Parfait(s) : Arnaques en Famille
overview_en: The Toussaint family are expert hustlers on the run who adopt the unassuming identities of the “Perfects” and settle in Scotland. As they juggle new jobs, nosy colleagues and a mysterious neighbor, their elaborate disguises, gadgets and insane schemes threaten to expose their double life.

title: Molière, Cyrano and the Young King
tagline: Wit, love and an undercover prince spark the beginning of French comedy.
overview_en: During the Paris rebellion, young Louis XIV must be hidden from danger and is secretly replaced at court by a look-alike. Entrusted to the musketeer-poet Cyrano de Bergerac, Louis is sheltered within Madeleine Béjart’s traveling theater troupe, where the actor and aspiring playwright Molière has just joined – unaware their newest member is the future king of France. As Cyrano struggles to handle the arrogant and clumsy young king, he begins writing a bold play for the troupe. Molière, bursting with ideas, transforms the work with wit and heart, awakening his genius for comedy and deepening his secret feelings for Madeleine, while young Louis discovers the joy of theater and the power of friendship. But back in Paris, intrigue is brewing – can the young king return in time before the masquerade is revealed and embrace his true royal destiny?

title: Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall
overview_en: Arkham Asylum has been destroyed, and all its inmates have been unleashed upon Gotham City. As Batman races to round up some of his greatest enemies, he is pushed to his physical and mental limits and into a final confrontation with a new threat: the man called Bane!

title: Voicemails for Isabelle
tagline: Sometimes the universe leaves you a message.
overview_en: A young woman's hilariously confessional voicemails to her late sister are unknowingly redirected to a stranger, who begins to fall in love from afar.
overview_id: Pengakuan lucu berupa pesan suara dari seorang wanita muda untuk mendiang saudarinya tanpa disadari terkirim ke pria tak dikenal, yang mulai jatuh hati dari kejauhan.

title: Fatherland
overview_en: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

title: Citizen Vigilante
tagline: An action film inspired by real events.
overview_en: A man takes justice into his own hands, hunting down criminals. His vigilante crusade makes him a social media star but puts him at odds with the local police chief.

title: All of a Sudden
tagline: One night. Two strangers. A lifetime of questions.
overview_en: Director of a care facility for the elderly, Marie-Lou strives to introduce an innovative care philosophy based on listening and respecting residents’ dignity, despite resistance from part of her staff. Her encounter with Mari, a Japanese theater director battling cancer, will profoundly reshape her path. By forming a deep, supportive friendship, the two women join forces in a shared struggle to make the impossible possible.

title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
overview_en: When Lord Murashige rises up against the tyrannical Oda, he finds himself besieged within the walls of his own castle. Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. With Oda's army closing in and a traitor hiding among his ranks, Murashige is forced into an uneasy alliance with Kanbei, a brilliant and dangerous strategist held prisoner in the dungeon, as he must outwit his enemies and uncover the truth before time runs out.

title: Cocktail 2
overview_en: A vacation in Sicily forces longtime partners Diya and Kunal to question their love and commitment after they reunite with Diya's old friend Ally.

title: Viva
overview_en: After coming face to face with death, 40-year-old Nora is consumed by an urgent need to feel alive. She dives into passionate relationships with two very different men, Tom and Max, whose opposing natures reflect her own inner conflict. But when neither can fill the void, Nora is forced to face the truth, she will have to confront a deeper fear driving her hunger for life.

title: I Know Who You Are
overview_en: On 1949 October 1, the day of the founding ceremony of the People's Republic of China, Xiao Dali enters the city and is reorganized as the director of the public security police station. He finds that primary school teacher Feng Jingbo is full of doubts. With the high vigilance of a soldier and the sense of responsibility of a public security official, Dali insists on partnering with Feng and becomes his neighbor. He then spends his whole life carrying out a nearly four-decade pursuit without regrets.

title: Balan - The Boy
overview_en: A teenage boy searches for his missing mother following a turbulent childhood and her subsequent disappearance, exploring his search for closure and the truth about his past.

title: Maddie's Secret
overview_en: A plucky dishwasher leaps to viral superstardom at a trendy food content creation company. While her life seems picturesque — complete with an adoring husband, ride-or-die best friend and a cupboard full of woman-owned ethically-sourced chili crisp to boot — mounting professional pressures threaten to reawaken a hidden secret from her troubled past.

title: Land of Wolves
overview_en: When a covert rescue mission goes wrong, four former Navy SEALs are captured and thrown into an underground death match. Watched by depraved billionaires, they are forced to fight in a brutal tournament. With no weapons and no way out, the team must rely on their training and unbreakable bond to survive the bloody arena, dismantle the entire operation and reclaim their freedom.

title: Stepfather
overview_en: After years of eradicating any family that falls short of perfection, Darnell believes his new wife Asia and her daughters might finally be the real deal. That is, until tensions rise and they uncover his deadly pattern. Now, getting rid of them won’t be as easy as he planned.

title: The Death of Robin Hood
overview_en: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

title: The Get Out
tagline: The night life is dirty business.
overview_en: A nightclub owner is on the verge of leaving his dangerous past behind for retirement with his girlfriend. When masked gunmen rob him and he finds himself squeezed by ruthless cartels, a mysterious newcomer arrives with an interest in buying the business. With danger closing in from all sides, he must navigate a deadly web of deception, power, and survival - where escape may no longer be an option.

title: Girls Like Girls
tagline: Love begins when you let it in.
overview_en: After her mother's passing, 17-year-old Coley navigates new feelings of intimacy with Sonya in rural Oregon, where both girls must overcome their mutual uncertainties and self-doubt to embrace their connection.

title: Little Brother
overview_en: A tightly wound realtor's picture-perfect life gets an extreme makeover when his lovably chaotic "little brother" suddenly reappears.
overview_id: Hidup sempurna seorang agen properti yang kaku mengalami perombakan ekstrem saat "adik lelaki"-nya yang kacau, tapi baik hati, tiba-tiba muncul lagi.

title: Cerita Lila
overview_en: Following a fatal history of severe maternal domestic abuse, the discarnate spirit of a young twin navigates the afterlife in a desperate search for her separated sister, uncovering a clandestine metaphysical conspiracy designed to obscure the truth of their deaths.
overview_id: Lila, arwah seorang gadis kecil yang masih terikat pada masa lalunya, terus mencari saudari kembarnya yang hilang, Lili. Kehidupannya berubah saat Nia dan ibunya, Tari, pindah ke rumah tempat Lila berada. Persahabatan yang terjalin antara Lila dan Nia membawa mereka pada pencarian yang perlahan membuka rahasia kelam yang lama terkubur. Ketika kehadiran sosok Rahma mulai mengancam keselamatan mereka, Nia meminta bantuan Sara Wijayanto dan Wisnu untuk mengungkap kebenaran di balik tragedi masa lalu.

title: Strung
overview_en: A talented violinist's prestigious new role as a music tutor for an enigmatic, elite family spirals into a psychological battle for her safety and sanity.

title: Maa Inti Bangaram
overview_en: Through both her moments of fear and bravery, a woman discovers that embracing her vulnerabilities is as vital to her inner strength as facing challenges head-on.

title: Here the Whole Time
overview_en: An insecure teenager's vacation plans are ruined by an unexpected visitor: his neighbor and school crush who will spend two weeks sleeping at his house. The days that promised peace, tranquility and epic series marathons end up bringing a whirlwind of feelings and unresolved issues.

title: Toy Story 5
overview_en: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

title: Leviticus
overview_en: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most: each other.

title: Your Fault: London
tagline: How do you hold onto true love after you've found it?
overview_en: Nick and Noah are both embarking on life-changing adventures that are threatening to pull them apart—Nick in business with his father and Noah starting a fresh chapter at Oxford University. Now living separate lives, and meeting new people, they find themselves entangled in temptations, rivalries, and betrayals and their bond is tested like never before. As secrets unravel and temptation rises, they must fight to hold onto each other—or risk losing everything.

title: Jim Queen
overview_en: When Heterosis, a mysterious virus that turns gay men straight, sweeps through the Parisian gay scene, Jim, the six-packed sovereign of the Gym Queens, goes from Pride royalty to social outcast. With only Lucien, a freshly-out twink with more heart than abs, still by his side, Jim must race to find a cure before the disease erases the community that once worshipped him.

title: Extreme Makeover: Homer Edition
overview_en: Homer and Marge's fun couples' date night goes off the rails when Marge learns Homer left the kids unsupervised with only the doorbell camera as a babysitter. Frustrated with her imperfect husband, a tipsy Marge stirs up a trilogy of fantasies of a different Homer.

title: The Stories
overview_en: The Stories is a decades-spanning Egyptian family saga and love story set between the late 1960s and 1980s. The film follows Ahmed, a young man from a Middle-Class Cairo family who dreams of becoming a concert pianist. During the tense summer of 1967, as war looms over Egypt, he begins a pen-pal correspondence with an Austrian woman named Elizabeth (“Liz”). A semi-autobiographical film based on the director's parents and how they met.

title: Deviens génial
overview_en: Mathias is a teacher and has finally been transferred to his daughter’s middle school. But no sooner has he arrived than he learns that his German class is being canceled due to a lack of students. He then decides to organize a trip to Germany to motivate the teens to choose the language, and to fund it, he turns to Iris, the head of the local sister city committee. The catch is that Mathias is a Spanish teacher. Between Mathias, who doesn’t speak a word of German, the frustrated teens, and an irrational Iris, the school trip is shaping up to be utter chaos. Yet nothing will stop him from becoming the father his daughter no longer expects… and to achieve his goal, he’ll have to become awesome!

title: Shana
overview_en: Shana navigates the trials and tribulations of everyday life with boundless energy and the support of her group of friends. When her grandmother passes away, she inherits a ring that is supposed to protect her from bad luck. Shana certainly needs this helping hand. Especially since her toxic partner has been released from prison, and misfortunes are piling up…

title: 40 Dates and 40 Nights
tagline: How many dates does it take to find love?
overview_en: Ready to quit the dating scene altogether, burned-out Leah accepts her grandmother's outrageous challenge—40 dates in 40 nights in exchange for a year's rent—only to discover amidst the awkward dinners and unexpected sparks that her biggest obstacle to love is herself.

title: Husbands in Action
tagline: A chaotic match, a reckless mission.
overview_en: A detective teams up with his ex-wife's new husband to chase down her kidnappers. Can this unlikely duo put aside their differences for one wild rescue?
overview_id: Seorang detektif bekerja sama dengan suami baru mantan istrinya untuk mengejar penculik si istri. Bisakah duo unik ini mengabaikan perbedaan demi satu penyelamatan nekat?

title: Fjord
overview_en: Following the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbet Gheorghiu leave their life behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbet's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth gives them hope for a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghiu family’s young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.

title: Travis Barker: Louder Than Fear
overview_en: After surviving a devastating plane crash that nearly took his life, legendary and electrifying drummer Travis Barker embarks on a raw and redemptive journey in this intimate portrait of the man behind the tattoos who transformed pain into power.

title: Dog Day Evening
overview_en: A hostage situation occurred at a TV station. The kidnapper K was not after money, he just wanted to terminate the monthly subscription to the TV station.

title: Stop! That! Train!
overview_en: Best friends and train stewardesses Tess and DeeDee trade their dreary shifts on the Stank Rail for the glitzy Glamazonian Express. However, when a catastrophic Stormaganza threatens to crash the high-speed train into Celebration, Florida, the duo in coach must join forces with the snobby first-class attendants, a hot but dimwitted co-conductor, and fabulous US President Judy Gagwell to save the day.

title: In the Hand of Dante
overview_en: A Vatican priest discovers Dante's original Divine Comedy manuscript. When asked to authenticate it, writer Nick Tosches steals it, while a parallel story follows Dante's quest to create his masterpiece.

title: A Family of Bastards
overview_en: After the death of his father, Mohamed discovers the living of a step-brother and a step-sister. Together, they must manage the suspicious bar they inherited of linked to criminality, drug traffic and prostitution.

title: Still Sexy
overview_en: Maddalena has it all: a job she loves, the perfect fiancé, and a dream wedding ahead. Yet in the bedroom, something feels wrong. Urged on by her inner voice, embodied by pornstar Valentina Nappi, she begins to question her life. Meeting Bruno, a gardener with a troubled past, leads her to rediscover herself and realize the only path worth following is her own.

title: Another League
overview_en: Spain, the 1970s. Although Francoist ideology remains deeply entrenched in society, a group of young trailblazers and an ambitious promoter are about to change the history of women’s football.

title: Time of Death
tagline: Beneath the darkness lies the truth.
overview_en: When a prisoner vanishes without a trace, Detective Frank Morley (Michael Kelly) is sent to a decaying prison on the verge of shutdown. What begins as a routine investigation quickly spirals into a dangerous search for answers.

title: Maternal Instinct
overview_en: Police pull over a woman who claims she just gave birth. But the baby — and the blood — aren't hers. Twisted lies unravel in this true-crime documentary.
overview_id: Polisi memberhentikan wanita yang mengaku baru saja melahirkan. Namun, bayi dan darah itu bukan miliknya. Kebohongan rumit terungkap dalam dokumenter kriminal nyata ini.

title: Main Vaapas Aaunga
tagline: A story of love and longing.
overview_en: Haunted by a childhood romance and recollections of love lost during the 1947 Partition of India, 95-year-old Ishar Singh Grewal shares his story with his grandson Nirvair, the past unfolding through memories of migration, longing, and a romance that endures across generations.

title: Disclosure Day
overview_en: A cybersecurity expert becomes a whistleblower after uncovering secrets about aliens, putting him on the run from a corporation. Meanwhile, a meteorologist experiencing strange phenomena joins forces with him to prove there's life beyond our understanding.
overview_id: Jika Anda mengetahui bahwa kita tidak sendirian, jika seseorang menunjukkannya kepada Anda, membuktikannya kepada Anda, apakah itu akan membuat Anda takut?

title: The Furious
tagline: To save their loved ones, they will fight everyone.
overview_en: When Wang Wei's daughter is abducted by a criminal organization and law enforcement declines to intervene due to corruption, Wei embarks on a solo mission to find her. His sole ally is Navin, a determined journalist whose wife has also mysteriously disappeared. Together, this improbable pair confronts the kidnappers in a fierce martial arts confrontation, driven by an intense desire for retribution.

title: Colors of Evil: Black
overview_en: Investigating the disappearance of children in a remote Polish town, prosecutor Leopold Bilski must unravel a sinister local legend before it's too late.
overview_id: Saat seorang anak lelaki hilang di kota kecil yang tenang, seorang jaksa yang baru ditugaskan kembali mengungkap hubungan tak terduga dengan kasus lama orang hilang.

title: Hallowarrior
tagline: The whole world is a haunted house.
overview_en: Pumpkin, the last girl on earth and sole survivor of a humanity-ending plague, scavenges the wasteland for supplies on the eve of Halloween. Pumpkin’s lonely holiday ritual is interrupted by the arrival of a savage gang of raiders at her doorstep, led by the fearsome Thalia. Outnumbered and armed with candy, wit and weapons, Pumpkin must ferociously fight back to survive the night.

title: Vertiginous
overview_en: Jacques goes to his friend Bruno's house to tell him some big news: the entire human race is living in a simulation...

title: Never Change!
tagline: It's never too late to finish what you failed.
overview_en: Nearly two decades after a devastating tornado abruptly cut their senior year short, a group of mid-30s adults must return to their hometown high school to complete their remaining requirements and finally graduate.

title: Never After Dark
original_title: Never After Dark／ネバーアフターダーク
overview_en: A traveling psychic who helps lost souls cross over encounters a powerful entity at a remote house. While investigating its origins, she uncovers dark secrets and faces a deadly threat from an unexpected source.

title: Carolina Caroline
overview_en: A young woman, desperate to leave her small town, runs away with a charming con man, embarking on a crime and passion-filled journey through the Southeast to find her estranged mother.

title: The Passenger
tagline: No way out. No way back.
overview_en: Hassan, a Somali-American airport shuttle driver in Minneapolis, is struggling to make ends meet. When Lloyd, a stranded twenty-something at the airport, offers to pay Hassan to take him overland to Chicago, it seems worth the risk. But as the realization grows that his passenger is not what he seems, Hassan finds himself trapped in a terrifying ride that he can’t escape, knowing that saving himself might put countless others in danger.

title: Signal One
overview_en: A computer scientist is invited by a tech billionaire to join his private facility on a Caribbean island to investigate extraterrestrial matter on Earth. When they make contact beyond our world, chaos erupts as we’re left to wonder: do they come in peace?

title: The Marked Woman
overview_en: When a woman is found in a shipping container with no memory of who she is, two detectives race to figure out her identity — and who wants her dead.
overview_id: Saat seorang wanita ditemukan di kontainer kargo dan dia hilang ingatan, dua detektif berlomba untuk menemukan identitasnya—dan siapa yang ingin wanita itu mati.

title: Savage House
tagline: Polite society has never been so Savage.
overview_en: Against the backdrop of 18th century England, a massive pox outbreak, and Jacobite uprising – Sir Chauncey Savage and Lady Savage blindly pursue a better life. It's not without a tinge of irony that their family name is the Savages, for this is a Savage House indeed, filled with duels, decadence, and bloodshed.

title: La luz
overview_en: A beloved parish priest, Manuel, is ready to leave the clergy and start anew. But when his past threatens to surface, he must face the consequences, beginning a journey that leads him to challenge the institution that protected him.

title: Gugu's World
overview_en: Gugu, a boy nearly 12 years old with a passion for soccer, lives with his grandmother, Dilma, a retired teacher who raised him in a free and loving environment, fostering a life of both security and creativity. With his grandmother’s health in decline, Gugu faces his first major challenge with the prospect of having to go live with his father, a stern man.

title: Mollywood Times
overview_en: Vineeth Madhavan tries hard to become Malayalam cinema's greatest horror filmmaker, but will the toxic industry affect his dream?

title: Parimala and Co
overview_en: A dark comedy centered around a chaotic family whose tangled relationships and unpredictable situations lead to emotionally charged and absurd moments, blending humor with underlying tension and drama.

title: All That We Never Were
overview_en: 19-year-old Leah navigates a coming-of-age journey in the wake of a tragic car accident that claims her parents. Relocated to a coastal town under the care of her brother’s best friend Axel, Leah grapples with grief, haunting nightmares and a fractured sense of self.

title: Office Romance
overview_en: Jackie, President and CEO of Air Cruz, runs a tight ship in her business, including a rigid anti-fraternization policy for all her employees. When a new sexy lawyer begins working for her, that policy becomes very tested.
overview_id: Jennifer Lopez dan Brett Goldstein membintangi komedi romantis seksi tentang romansa rahasia di kantor dan kekacauan yang dihadapi dua penggila kerja ini karena cinta.

title: Bandar
overview_en: TV star Samar's life spirals when his ex Gayatri accuses him of rape after he blocks contact with her. Despite his new relationship with Khushi, he faces arrest and encounters a corrupt justice system.

title: Find Your Friends
overview_en: A sinister spin on twenty-something party culture, revealing the darkness beneath the carefree facade. What starts as a wild girls trip turns dangerous when hostile locals escalate tensions and Amber's past trauma surfaces. As the group fractures under toxic dynamics, their fun getaway transforms into a revenge-fueled nightmare.

title: Summer on Asphalt
overview_en: Les (Mala Emde) lives life fast, spontaneously, and carefree. By day, she races through the city as a bike courier; after work, she's off partying with her friends. Stopping, pausing, or thinking about the future? Not for Les. At least not until her father, Bert (Christoph Maria Herbst) – with whom she has virtually no contact – unexpectedly shows up at her door and, after an accident, even hops on his bike for his daughter without being asked. When Les then learns of her unplanned pregnancy, she's completely thrown into a new reality. The expectant father, Tyler (Aaron Hilmer), would love a child, but unfortunately, he's still a child himself. Les's world is turned upside down – and Bert hasn't even told her yet that he's going to die soon...

title: Smart Working
overview_en: The story follows Giuliano, whose life has improved thanks to his working from home, but his colleagues’ poor performance threatens to force everyone back to the office. Meanwhile, he and his wife, Laura, are expecting a second child and are looking for a bigger home. As Laura makes up her mind about a controversial job offer, Giuliano’s co-workers turn their flat into a makeshift office, rekindling their efficiency and organisation. Amid intrusive co-workers and domestic chaos, Giuliano will have to find creative solutions to save his job, his family and the dream of a new home.

title: Poldi
overview_en: Footballer, entrepreneur, fan favorite and true community hero — Lukas Podolski reflects on his journey and what comes next in this intimate documentary.
overview_id: Pesepak bola, pengusaha, favorit penggemar, dan pahlawan masyarakat sejati—Lukas Podolski merenungkan perjalanannya dan apa yang menantinya dalam dokumenter intim ini.

title: Scary Movie
overview_en: Twenty-six years after outrunning a suspiciously familiar masked killer, the Core Four are back in the killer's crosshairs and no horror movie IP is safe.

title: Masters of the Universe
overview_en: After being separated for 15 years, the Sword of Power leads Prince Adam back to Eternia, where he discovers his home shattered under the fiendish rule of Skeletor. To save his family and his world, Adam must join forces with his closest allies, Teela and Duncan/Man-At-Arms, and embrace his true destiny as He-Man — the most powerful man in the universe.

title: De Gaulle: Résistance
original_title: La Bataille de Gaulle : L’Âge de fer
tagline: Some wars are won by armies. Others by those who refuse to surrender.
overview_en: June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom.

title: Hungry
overview_en: A group of holidaymakers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose after becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands.

title: Peddi
overview_en: In a village that doesn't officially exist, a laborer's unmatched athletic talent becomes his weapon to fight for his people's right to be recognized.

title: Wild Sing
overview_en: Twenty years after a scandal tears apart a popular 2000s K‑pop trio, the three reunite for a one-off gig — if they can overcome one snag after another.

title: Earth, Wind & Fire (To Be Celestial vs. That's the Weight of the World)
original_title: Earth, Wind & Fire (To Be Celestial vs. That's the Weight of the World)
overview_en: Examines the legacy, cultural impact, and body of work of American R&B/funk/jazz/soul/disco band Earth, Wind & Fire, and will feature exclusive access to the band’s archives of visual, audio, and written material, as well as the support of the estate of Maurice White and the band.

title: Bouchra
overview_en: Wrestling with writer’s block for her first film, Bouchra, a queer Moroccan jackal living in NYC, starts having difficult yet overdue phone calls with her mother in Casablanca that begin influencing the project. Balancing the precarity of working as an artist, the rift in her cultural identity and an array of romantic interests, Bouchra’s emotional reckoning becomes her path to expression.

title: Instadocs: Alex Murdaugh, Unconvicted
overview_en: Why was Alex Murdaugh's conviction overturned? The debut of "Instadocs" digs into stunning allegations of jury interference in his double murder trial.

title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Key to the Castle
original_title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Key to the Castle
tagline: Behind the scenes. Beyond the grave
overview_en: When a ghost hunter show comes to town, it's up to Gethsemane and Eamon to solve the unexpected murder of the host, allowing the brand-new spirit to cross-over.

title: Tied Up
overview_en: Daniel Lonces is a successful horror writer who decides to put himself in his protagonist’s shoes and experience firsthand what it means to be tied and gagged. But a tragic accident leaves his wife dead, him trapped, and his 11-month-old baby defenseless. Desperate, David struggles to free himself while facing unexpected dangers inside and outside his home.

title: The Breadwinner
tagline: One dad. Three kids. Zero clue.
overview_en: After his wife Katie lands a once-in-a-lifetime deal on Shark Tank that takes her on a prolonged business trip - lifelong breadwinner Nate Wilcox now has to fend for his family as a first-time stay-at-home dad.

title: Ninja Wars: BlackFox vs Shogun's Ninja
overview_en: Rikka Isurugi (Chihiro Yamamoto), head of the Fox Clan, is investigating the "White Lotus," a mysterious cult suspected of plotting a rebellion against the Shogunate. During her mission, she encounters Okyo (Kanon Miyahara), a Fuma Ninja dispatched by the Shogun. Their paths converge as they face a formidable common enemy: the Iga Ninja clan, led by Hattori Hanzo (Kane Kosugi), who harbors a deep vengeance against the Tokugawa family. A three-way conflict between the Fox Clan, Fuma Ninja, and Iga Ninja is about to begin.

title: Sheep in the Box
overview_en: In the near future, architect Otone Komoto is married to Kensuke, who runs a construction company. The married couple decide to welcome a humanoid robot into their home as their son.

title: Miss You, Love You
tagline: People have a funny way of growing on you.
overview_en: Forced to plan her late husband's funeral with her estranged gay son's assistant, a blunt, grieving widow forms an unlikely bond with the total stranger as confronting their shared grief surfaces deep family secrets and long-held resentments.

title: Mononoke the Movie: Chapter III - The Curse of the Serpent
original_title: 劇場版モノノ怪 第三章 蛇神
overview_en: When tragedy strikes within the walls of the Ōoku, twisted human passions and festering grudges spawn the Medicine Seller's most fearsome opponent yet.

title: Mallorca confidencial
overview_en: Mallorca, 2007. La Chusa, the matriarch of a shantytown, runs the drug market with the support of neighbors, traffickers, and police. But when she suffers a massive robbery, she sees her power and her family shaken.

title: Pressure
tagline: In the hours before D-Day, one decision changed the world.
overview_en: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

title: Blast
overview_en: A seemingly ordinary family must unleash their hidden martial arts skills when they clash with a ruthless criminal gang tied to corruption and violence.

title: WHO
overview_en: In a high-stakes world where time is scarce and every choice matters, diverse characters face a merciless system where one wrong move means death. Amid intense pressure, they confront moral quandaries and seek truth while testing limits.

title: Innamorarsi e altre pessime idee
overview_en: A successful lawyer whose wife left him for a charming chef devises a complicated plan for revenge involving a woman in trouble with the law.

title: Backrooms
overview_en: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.
overview_id: Setelah pasien seorang terapis menghilang ke dimensi di luar realitas, dia harus menjelajah ke tempat yang tidak dikenal untuk menyelamatkannya.

title: 7 Dogs
overview_en: Interpol agent Khalid Al-Azzazi joins forces with Ghali Abu Dawood from the 7 Dogs crime syndicate to fight drug trafficking.

title: Chum
tagline: There's no hiding in the sea.
overview_en: A newlywed couple joins friends on a Mediterranean yacht excursion, only to find themselves caught between a predatory shark and a psychopathic killer in their midst-transforming a sun-drenched escape into a fight for survival.

title: Mata
overview_en: Wounded while on a clandestine operation in Niger, French secret agent Mata loses track of her colleague Antoine, captured on the spot. Upon her return, she volunteers for a counter-espionage mission in the Alps, with the intuition that this new assignment might somehow be connected to her traumatic mission in Africa. Haunted by Antoine’s captivity and convinced that her managers are hiding information from her, Mata embarks on a race against time, outside any official framework... at the risk of losing everything.

title: Crescendo
overview_en: In the ruins of a Roman amphitheatre in the South of France, the cast and crew of an ambitious staging of The Marriage of Figaro is thrown off balance when troubling accusations threaten to derail the entire production. As tensions intensify, loyalties slowly fracture and deep generational disagreement emerges, throwing their sheltered opera world into a great divide.

title: It’s All Good
overview_en: After taking care of his intrusive mother for years, Elie is relieved: she is cured. He can finally focus on his own life and falls in love… until his mom’s relapse. Now he has to take care of both the women in his life!

title: Untold UK: Vinnie Jones
overview_en: This is the story of Vinnie Jones's rise, fall, and comeback against odds – and red cards – from one of football's most notorious hard men to FA cup winner.

title: AEW Double or Nothing 2026
overview_en: The 2026 Double or Nothing was a professional wrestling pay-per-view produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on May 24, 2026, at Louis Armstrong Stadium in New York City, New York, USA. It featured the first quarter-final matches of the 2026 Owen Hart Foundation Tournaments for both the men and women, as well as the long-anticipated AEW International Championship match between Don Callis Family members Kazuchika Okada (c) and Konosuke Takeshita. The show was headlined by Darby Allin (c) vs. MJF in a Title vs. Hair match for the AEW World Championship, where MJF would have to shave his head bald if he lost.

title: Josh Johnson: Symphony
overview_en: In his first HBO comedy special, comedian Josh Johnson debuts original material about our shared experiences as humans – tackling topics like family, religion, and relationships through his unique point of view and signature creativity.

title: Master of the Universe
overview_en: A young man must use his untapped powers to fight back against an evil alien and their army, who will stop at nothing to take over Earth and then the universe.

title: Saccharine
overview_en: After succumbing to an obscure weight-loss craze involving the eating of human ashes, lovelorn medical student Hana finds herself haunted by the ghost of the person she's eating.

title: Chand Mera Dil
tagline: When love grows faster than life
overview_en: Aarav and Chandni's passionate college romance is struck by adulthood far too soon, forcing the two young lovers to balance their ambitions with responsibility and realize the evolved meaning of love.

title: Corporate Retreat
overview_en: Blending the dread of survival horror with dark laughs and shocking twists, "Corporate Retreat" centers around a group of young executives whose luxury team-building trip descends into a bloody fight for survival against a vengeful retreat leader.

title: Colony
overview_en: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.
overview_id: Profesor Se-jeong terjerumus ke dalam mimpi buruk berdarah ketika virus yang bermutasi dengan cepat dilepaskan selama konferensi bioteknologi, menyebabkan pihak berwenang menutup fasilitas tersebut. Terperangkap di dalam tanpa jalan keluar, Se-jeong bersama sekelompok kecil penyintas harus berjuang untuk tetap hidup sementara mereka yang terinfeksi mengalami transformasi mengerikan.

title: Tuner
overview_en: A gifted piano tuner's meticulous skills for tuning pianos lead him to discover an unexpected aptitude for cracking safes, turning his life upside down.

title: Finding Emily
overview_en: When a lovesick musician is given the wrong number for his dream girl, he teams up with a driven psychology student to find her. Together, they spark a hilarious campus-wide frenzy that tests their own hearts and ambitions along the way.

title: Ladies First
overview_en: An arrogant but charismatic ladies' man finds his life of money, power and casual flings upended when he wakes up in a parallel world dominated by women.
overview_id: Kehidupan seorang playboy arogan, tetapi karismatik, yang penuh uang, kekuasaan, dan kencan iseng berubah total saat ia terbangun di dunia paralel yang didominasi wanita.

title: I Love Boosters
tagline: Booster: Somebody who steals clothes from a store and sells them at a discount price, aka community service.
overview_en: A group of shoplifters take aim at a cutthroat fashion maven by stealing from her stores and reselling them at a lower price — what they call 'fashion-forward philanthropy'.

title: Mexico 86
tagline: Not all goals are scored on the field.
overview_en: When a last-minute chance to host the 1986 World Cup appears, a cunning Mexican bureaucrat, armed with nothing but guts and audacity, cons his way through FIFA to beat the United States, but in a country of power games, every victory has a price.
overview_id: Keberanian, kegilaan, dan kecerdikan ala Meksiko. Meski sulit, Meksiko menjadi tuan rumah turnamen terpenting dalam sepak bola pada 1986. Bagaimana hal ini bisa tercapai?

title: A Machu Picchu Proposal
overview_en: Katie agrees to join her brother Dan and his girlfriend Luciana on a trip to Peru. Dan plans to propose to Luciana in a grand way at Machu Picchu at the end of the week and needs Katie’s Spanish speaking skills to ask Luciana’s Peruvian father for his blessing. However, when Luciana’s friend, Chef Carlos, arrives, he accidentally ruins each proposal attempt.
